```{r functions, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson="setup"}
round_to_decimal_half <- function(x) {
  round(x / 0.05) * 0.05
}

round_to_half <- function(x) {
  if (x < 5) {final = x} else
  {final = round(x / 5) * 5}
  final
}

#########################################
##### REORDER SPECIES PAIRS ###########
#########################################

reorder_pairs = function(missing_species_pairs, ordered_species) {
  # Remove duplicates
  unique_pairs = unique(missing_species_pairs)
  
  # Convert pairs into a data frame for sorting
  df = data.frame(
    pair = unique_pairs,
    species1 = sub("-.*", "", unique_pairs),  # Extract first species
    species2 = sub(".*-", "", unique_pairs)   # Extract second species
  )
  
  # Get order indices from `ordered_species`
  df$order1 = match(df$species1, ordered_species)
  df$order2 = match(df$species2, ordered_species)
  
  final_df = df %>%
    mutate(total = order1 + order2) %>%
    mutate(total_1 = ifelse(species1 %in% Deuterostoma & species2 %in% Deuterostoma, 1, 0)) %>%
    arrange(total, total_1)

  return(final_df$pair)
}


#######################################
########## PHYLOGENETIC TREE ##########
#######################################

tree_y <-  function(ggtree, data){
  if(!inherits(ggtree, "ggtree"))
    stop("not a ggtree object")
  left_join(select(data, label), select(ggtree$data, label, y)) %>%
    pull(y)
}

#This is just to see if I can actually paier a ggtree with a ggplot decently.
# overwrite the default expand for continuous scales
scale_y_tree <- function(expand=expand_scale(0, 0.6), ...){
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expand, ...)
}

# get the range of the ggtree y-axis data
tree_ylim <- function(ggtree){
  if(!inherits(ggtree, "ggtree"))
    stop("not a ggtree object")
  range(ggtree$data$y)
}

# plot data next to a ggtree aligned by shared labels
ggtreeplot <- function(ggtree, data = NULL, mapping = aes(), flip=FALSE,
     expand_limits=expand_scale(0,.6), ...){
  
  if(!inherits(ggtree, "ggtree"))
    stop("not a ggtree object")

  # match the tree limits
  limits <- tree_ylim(ggtree)
  limits[1] <- limits[1] + (limits[1] * expand_limits[1]) - expand_limits[2]
  limits[2] <- limits[2] + (limits[2] * expand_limits[3]) + expand_limits[4]
  
  if(flip){
    mapping <- modifyList(aes_(x=~x), mapping)
    data <- mutate(data, x=tree_y(ggtree, data))
    gg <- ggplot(data=data, mapping = mapping, ...) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=limits, expand=c(0,0))
  }else{
    mapping <- modifyList(aes_(y=~y), mapping)
    data <- mutate(data, y=tree_y(ggtree, data))
    gg <- ggplot(data=data, mapping = mapping, ...) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=limits, expand=c(0,0))
  }
  gg
}

create_diagonal_polygons = function(df, input_x, input_y, value1, value2) {
  polygons = df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      poly1 = list(data.frame(
        x = c({{input_x}} - 0.5, {{input_x}} + 0.5, {{input_x}} - 0.5),
        y = c({{input_y}} - 0.5, {{input_y}} + 0.5, {{input_y}} + 0.5),
        fill = value1
      )),
      poly2 = list(data.frame(
        x = c({{input_x}} + 0.5, {{input_x}} + 0.5, {{input_x}} - 0.5),
        y = c({{input_y}}+ 0.5, {{input_y}} - 0.5, {{input_y}} - 0.5),
        fill = value2
      ))) %>%
    select(poly1, poly2) %>%
    unnest(c(poly1, poly2))

  return(polygons)
}

rep_fill <- function(x, each, len) {
  v <- rep(x, each = each)
  if (length(v) < len) {
    v <- c(v, rep(tail(v, 1), len - length(v)))
  } else if (length(v) > len) {
    v <- v[1:len]
  }
  v
}

get_legend_safe <- function(p, position = c("bottom", "right", "left", "top", "inside")) {
  position <- match.arg(position)
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

  guide_name <- paste0("guide-box-", position)

  if (!guide_name %in% g$layout$name) {
    stop("No legend found at position: ", position)
  }

  g$grobs[[which(g$layout$name == guide_name)]]
}


##########################################
############# ASYMPOTE COMPUTAT###########
##########################################

compute_asymptote <- function(df, epsilon = 0.005) {

  df$delta_frac_all <- c(NA, diff(df$cum_frac_all))
  df$x <- seq_len(nrow(df))

  d <- na.omit(df[, c("x", "delta_frac_all")])

  # --- TEST 1: detectable deceleration ---
  lm_decay <- lm(delta_frac_all ~ x, data = d)
  slope <- coef(lm_decay)[["x"]]
  pval  <- summary(lm_decay)$coefficients["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]

  deceleration_detected <- (slope < 0) && (pval < 0.05)

  if (!deceleration_detected) {
    return(list(
      ref_asymptote = NA,
      ref_saturation = NA,
      reason = "No detectable saturation curvature"
    ))
  }

  # --- TEST 2: fit model only if justified ---
  fit <- nls(
    cum_frac_all ~ (a * x)/(b + x),
    data = df,
    start = list(
      a = max(df$cum_frac_all) * 1.2,
      b = median(df$x)
    )
  )

  a <- coef(fit)[["a"]]
  saturation <- tail(df$cum_frac_all,1) / a

  list(
    ref_asymptote = a,
    ref_saturation = saturation,
    reason = "Asymptote estimable"
  )
}

########### FIND COMMON ANCESTOR #########

find_LCA_clade = function(species_vec, clades) {
  for (clade_name in names(clades)) {
    if (all(species_vec %in% clades[[clade_name]])) {
      return(clade_name)
    }
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}
```

```{r TS-AS_TS-GE-raw_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
##### Panel A is going to be a nice scheme: (1) phylogeny; (2) tissues; (3) Ancestral gene orthogroups (manually drawn)
##### Panel B is going to contain (1) a dot-plot with the total number of TS-AS and TS-GE genes by tissue (side by side; the regulatory layer is differentiated by the alpha; the genes with double-TS are represented twice (once per tissue)); (2) a barplot on the right with the total numbers of TS-AS and TS-GE genes across species (genes with double-TS are represented only once); (3) a barplot on the bottom with the total numbers of TS-AS and TS-GE genes across tissues (genes with double-TS are represented twice)

#################################
############ INPUTS #############
#################################

### The input for the AS-regulated genes has already been filtered for genes containing UP exons
### The inputs have already been filtered for bilaterian-conserved genes only
all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df = data.frame()

for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    #Upload inputs
    AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue))
    GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue))
    
    #Get TS-regulated genes
    AS_genes = unique(as.vector(AS_regulated_df$GeneID))
    GE_genes = unique(as.vector(GE_regulated_df$GeneID))
    #Get total number of genes
    tot_AS_genes = length(AS_genes)
    tot_GE_genes = length(GE_genes)
    #Combine into a unique dataframe (this is different frorm the thesis)
    species_df = data.frame(Species = species,
                            Tissue = tissue,
                            AS = tot_AS_genes,
                            GE = tot_GE_genes)
    #Append to final dataframe
    all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df, species_df)
  }
}

### Format dataframe
all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_long_df = all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("AS", "GE"), names_to="Reg_type", values_to="Tot_genes") %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),
         Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(ordered_species)),
         Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("AS", "GE")))


#################################
########## PLOT #################
#################################

### Tree
dist_table = read.delim(paste0(evo_distances_dir, "ancestor_distances-vts_codes.txt"), header=TRUE, row=1)
dist_matrix = as.matrix(dist_table)
unrooted_tree = nj(dist_matrix)
rooted_tree = root(unrooted_tree, "Nve", resolve.root=TRUE)
rooted_tree = drop.tip(rooted_tree, "Nve")

my_ggtree = ggtree(rooted_tree) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expand_scale(0.2)) +
  scale_y_tree()


### Counts
TS_genes_all_counts_plot = ggplot(all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_long_df, aes(x=Reg_type, y=Species, fill=Tissue, alpha=Reg_type, size=Tot_genes, shape=Reg_type)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=tissue_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c("AS"=0.9, "GE"=0.5)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c("AS"=21, "GE"=21)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range=c(0,12), name="Tot genes") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color="black", angle=30, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        #strip.text = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),
        legend.position="top") +
  facet_wrap(~Tissue, ncol=8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels=species_labels) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("AS"="TS-AS", "GE"="TS-GE")) +
  guides(fill="none", alpha="none")


######## Add counts by species on the side
TS_genes_counts_by_species_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  for (reg_type in c("GE", "AS")) {
    #Upload inputs
    if (reg_type == "AS") {
    regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "ExonID", "Tissue", "Direction")) } else {
    regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
    }
    #Get regulated genes
    reg_genes = unique(as.vector(regulated_df$GeneID))
    #Get total number of genes per species (count genes that are TS in more than one tissue only once)
    tot_reg_genes = length(reg_genes)
    #Combine into a unique dataframe (this is different from the thesis)
    species_df = data.frame(Species = species,
                            Tissue = tissue,
                            Reg_type = reg_type,
                            Tot_by_species = tot_reg_genes)
    #Append to final dataframe
    TS_genes_counts_by_species_df = dplyr::bind_rows(TS_genes_counts_by_species_df, species_df)
  }
}

TS_genes_counts_by_species_df = TS_genes_counts_by_species_df %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(ordered_species))) %>%
  mutate(Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("GE", "AS")))

TS_genes_by_species_plot = ggplot(data=TS_genes_counts_by_species_df, aes(y=Species, x=Tot_by_species, fill=Species, group=Reg_type, alpha=Reg_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position = position_stack()) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Tot_by_species), position = position_stack(vjust=0.5), color = "black", size=3, alpha=1) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c("AS"=0.9, "GE"=0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=species_colors) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y =element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        ) +
  guides(fill=FALSE, alpha=FALSE, group=FALSE)


######## Add counts by tissue below
TS_genes_counts_by_tissue_df = all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_long_df %>%
  group_by(Tissue, Reg_type) %>%
  summarize(Tot_by_tissue = sum(Tot_genes)) %>%
  mutate(Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("GE", "AS")))

TS_genes_by_tissue_plot = ggplot(data=TS_genes_counts_by_tissue_df, aes(y=Tot_by_tissue, x=Tissue, fill=Tissue, group=Reg_type, alpha=Reg_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position = position_stack()) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c("AS"=0.9, "GE"=0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Tot_by_tissue), position = position_stack(vjust=0.5), color = "black", alpha=1, size=3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=tissue_colors) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks =element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill=FALSE, alpha=FALSE, group=FALSE) +
  scale_y_reverse()

######## Combine plots and save to file
TS_raw_stats_plot = my_ggtree + TS_genes_all_counts_plot + TS_genes_by_species_plot + plot_spacer() + TS_genes_by_tissue_plot + plot_spacer() + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.3, 1, 0.3), nrow=2, heights = c(1,0.2))

print(TS_raw_stats_plot)
```

```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-overlap_scatterplot-horizontal, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
#################################
############ INPUTS #############
#################################

### The input for the AS-regulated genes has already been filtered for genes containing UP exons
### The inputs have already been filtered for bilaterian-conserved genes only
all_species_overlap_df = vector()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  #Get regulated genes genes
  AS_genes = unique(as.vector(AS_regulated_df$GeneID))
  GE_genes = unique(as.vector(GE_regulated_df$GeneID))
  #Get total number of genes
  tot_AS_genes = length(AS_genes)
  tot_GE_genes = length(GE_genes)
  #Get overlap
  overlap_genes = length(AS_genes[AS_genes %in% GE_genes])
  #Combine into a unique dataframe (this is different from the thesis)
  species_df = data.frame(Species = species,
                          AS = tot_AS_genes,
                          Overlap = overlap_genes,
                          GE = tot_GE_genes)
  #Join all dataframes
  all_species_overlap_df = rbind(all_species_overlap_df, species_df)
}

all_species_overlap_long_df = all_species_overlap_df %>%

  scale_color_manual(values=c("AS"="dodgerblue3", "GE"="brown3", "Overlap"="mediumpurple3"), labels=c("AS"="TS-AS", "GE"="TS-GE", "Overlap"="Both"), name="TS type:") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", hjust=1, vjust=1, angle=45),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=rel(1)),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        #legend.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top")
        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = number_ticks(10), limits=c(0,1600), name="Number of genes") +
```

<!-- Panel B: Feature differences between TS-AS and TS-GE genes -->
```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-all_features_randomization_inputs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

#### This is just to generate the input necessary for panel B

##########################################
########### INPUT FOR PARALOGS ###########
##########################################

### Number of paralogs for all bilaterian conserved genes
bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df = read.delim(paste0(home, "projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"),
                                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

geneID_paralog_number_df = bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  ### I define number of paralogs as the total number of genes from the same species in the same orthogroup
  mutate(Paralog_num = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Paralog_num)


##########################################
########### JOINT INPUTS #################
##########################################

#### For each species, upload GE, AS and ALL tables
all_randomized_species_features_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  print(species) #To keep track of progress
  for (rand_category in paste0("randomization_", seq(1,10))) {
    for (reg_type in c("GE", "AS")) {
      ### Genomic features
      features_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-gene_length_and_exon_num.tab"), 
                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Gene_length", "Exon_num"))
      ### Sequence similarity
      seq_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_sequence_similarities.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Seq_sim"))
      ### Expression similarity
      expr_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_expression_similarities.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Expr_sim"))
      ### Intergenic distances
      int_dist_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-intergenic_distances.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Int_dist"))
      ### Domain number
      domain_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-total_dom_num.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dom_num"))
      ### Disordered rates
      dis_rate_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_dis_rate.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dis_rate"))
      ### Combine dataframes
      reg_type_df = features_df %>%
        mutate(Species = species,
               Reg_type = reg_type,
               Rand_category = rand_category) %>%
        left_join(geneID_paralog_number_df, by="GeneID") %>%
        left_join(seq_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(expr_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(int_dist_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(domain_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(dis_rate_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
      
      all_randomized_species_features_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_randomized_species_features_df, reg_type_df)
    }
  }
}

##########################################
######### COMBINE INPUTS #################
##########################################

### Format input
all_randomized_species_features_formatted_df = all_randomized_species_features_df %>%
  mutate(Dom_num = Dom_num / Gene_length) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Paralog_num", "Seq_sim", "Expr_sim", "Int_dist", "Dom_num", "Dis_rate"), names_to="Feature", values_to="Values") %>%
  group_by(Species, Rand_category, Reg_type, Tissue, Feature) %>%
  summarize(Mean_value = mean(Values, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("Species", "Rand_category", "Tissue", "Feature"), names_from=Reg_type, values_from=Mean_value) %>%
  mutate(GE_AS_ratio = log2(AS/GE)) %>%
  ### Compute median by Rand_category
  group_by(Rand_category, Feature) %>%
  summarize(Median_value = median(GE_AS_ratio, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ### Compute the average of the medians, so to get only one value per feature
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarize(Average_median_value = mean(Median_value, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels=c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Expr_sim", "Dis_rate", "Seq_sim", "Int_dist", "Paralog_num", "Dom_num"))) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = ifelse(Feature %in% c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Dis_rate", "Expr_sim"), "AS_higher", "No_diff")) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = ifelse(Feature %in% c("Paralog_num", "Dom_num", "Int_dist"), "GE_higher", Feature_group)) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = factor(Feature_group, levels=c("AS_higher", "No_diff", "GE_higher")))
```

<!-- Panel C: Stats GO categories significant in a given number of tissues (x) by reg type -->
```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-GO_enrichments_by_species, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=10, fig.height=20}
###########################################
########### INPUT BACKGROUND ##############
###########################################

gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_backgrounds_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))


###########################################
########### INPUT ANNOTATION ##############
###########################################

OG_annotation_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/GO_transfers/All_version2/GO_annot/Hs2_transfers/orthogroups_from_Hs2-transferred_GO-Bilateria_conserved.txt"
OG_annotation_df = read.delim(OG_annotation_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "GO_ID", "GO_Name"))

###########################################
############ HYPERGEO TEST ################
###########################################

GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### Generate annotation
  species_annotation_df = all_species_backgrounds_df %>%
    left_join(OG_annotation_df, by="OG_ID") %>%
    filter(Species == species) %>%
    ### Remove not annotated genes
    filter(!(is.na(GO_Name))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-OG_ID, -Species, -GO_ID) %>%
    distinct()
  
  ### Select background (all genes belonging to bilaterian conserved orthogroups)
  background_genes = all_species_backgrounds_df %>%
    dplyr::select(-OG_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(Species == species) %>%
    .$GeneID %>%
    as.vector()
  
  background_counts_df = species_annotation_df %>%
    filter(GeneID %in% background_genes) %>%
    group_by(GO_Name) %>%
    summarize(K = n(), .groups="drop")
  
  for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
    for (reg_type in c("AS", "GE")) {
      
      ### Upload genes to be tested
      regulated_genes = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
        .$GeneID %>%
        unique()
      
      #### Compute hypergeo test
      regulated_genes_counts_df = species_annotation_df %>%
        filter(GeneID %in% regulated_genes) %>%
        group_by(GO_Name) %>%
        summarize(k = n(), .groups="drop")
      
      hypergeo_res_df = regulated_genes_counts_df %>%
        left_join(background_counts_df, by="GO_Name") %>%
        mutate(n = length(regulated_genes),
               N = length(background_genes),
               p0 = K/N,
               p1 = k/n) %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        #Perform the hypergeo test
        mutate(pval = phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail = FALSE)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(Obs_vs_Exp_ratio = p1/p0) %>%
        mutate(Reg_type = reg_type,
               Species = species,
               Tissue = tissue)
      
      #### Join to final dataframe
      GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df = GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(hypergeo_res_df)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-significant_GO_by_tot_tissues, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warrning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
########################################
```

```{r TS_AS-TS_GE-gene_orthogroup_impact, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.height=6, fig.width=5}
######### Code adapted from BB1 (it is indeed my old coding style)
#### I am separating gene orthogroups with TS-GE only, with TS-AS only and with both.

all_final_mat = vector()
for (reg_type in c("AS", "GE")) {
  if (reg_type == "GE") {other_reg_type = "AS"} else {other_reg_type = "GE"}
  final_mat = vector()
  current_species = vector()
  for (index in seq(1, length(ordered_species))) {
    new_species = ordered_species[index]
    current_species = c(current_species, ordered_species[index])
    current_OGs_df = subset(all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df, Species %in% current_species)
    TS_OGs_df = subset(current_OGs_df, Reg_type %in% reg_type)
    
    ### Exclude gene orthogroups that present both reg type
    TS_OGs_df = TS_OGs_df %>% filter(!(OG_ID %in% OG_with_both))
    TS_OGs_num = length(unique(as.vector(TS_OGs_df$OG_ID)))
    TS_OGs_proportion = TS_OGs_num/tot_OGs
    
    ### Compute the number of orthogroups with TS genes in the considered species
    species_TS_OGs = length(unique(as.vector(subset(all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df, 
                                                    Reg_type %in% reg_type & 
                                                      Species == new_species &
                                                      !(OG_ID %in% OG_with_both))$OG_ID)))
    species_TS_OGs_proportion = species_TS_OGs/tot_OGs
    final_mat = rbind(final_mat, c(length(current_species), species_TS_OGs, species_TS_OGs_proportion, TS_OGs_num, TS_OGs_proportion, new_species, reg_type))
  }
  all_final_mat = rbind(all_final_mat, final_mat)
}
```

```{r TS_AS-TS_GE-gene_orthogroup_species_distribs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=3, fig.height=6}
all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_reg_genes_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

###############################
########## PROCESS ############
###############################

OG_with_GE = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "GE") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()
OG_with_AS = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "AS") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()
OG_with_both = OG_with_GE[OG_with_GE %in% OG_with_AS]

### Compute proportions of species with genes annotated in both, only GE, only AS, None.
species_tool_overlap_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>%
  #filter(OG_ID %in% OG_with_both) %>%
  mutate(Reg_type = ifelse(is.na(Reg_type), "None", Reg_type)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(value = "YES") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Reg_type, values_from = value, values_fill = "NO") %>%
    mutate(Classification = case_when(
    AS == "YES" & GE == "YES" ~ "Both",
    AS == "YES" & GE == "NO" ~ "AS_only",
    AS == "NO"  & GE == "YES" ~ "GE_only",
    TRUE ~ "None"
  )) %>%
  group_by(OG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Tot_species = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Classification, Tot_species) %>%
  summarize(Tot_classification = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(Prop_classification = Tot_classification/Tot_species) %>%
  mutate(Classification = factor(Classification, levels=rev(c("Both", "GE_only", "AS_only", "None"))))

###### Get plotting order:
final_species_tool_overlap_df <- species_tool_overlap_df %>%
  group_by(OG_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    AS_only_n = sum(Tot_classification[Classification == "AS_only"], na.rm = TRUE),
    GE_only_n = sum(Tot_classification[Classification == "GE_only"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Both_n    = sum(Tot_classification[Classification == "Both"],   na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_order = case_when(
      AS_only_n > 0 & GE_only_n == 0 & Both_n == 0 ~ 1L,  # only AS_only
      GE_only_n > 0 & AS_only_n == 0 & Both_n == 0 ~ 2L,  # only GE_only
      Both_n > 0 | (GE_only_n > 0 & AS_only_n > 0) ~ 3L,  # Both or (GE & AS)
      TRUE                                            ~ 4L   # others
    ),
    ### optional tie-breaker logic
    score = rank_order * 1e12 - GE_only_n * 1e6 - AS_only_n * 1e3 - Both_n
  ) %>%
  mutate(OG_ID = fct_reorder(as.factor(OG_ID), score, .fun = min)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-AS_only_n, -GE_only_n, -Both_n, -rank_order, -score)

###############################
########## PLOT ###############
###############################

  scale_fill_manual(values=alpha(c("GE_only"="brown3", "AS_only"="dodgerblue3", "Both"="mediumpurple3", "None"="gray88"), alpha=0.03)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=alpha(c("GE_only"="brown3", "AS_only"="dodgerblue3", "Both"="mediumpurple3", "None"="gray88"), alpha=0.03)) +
```

```{r All_OG_groups-GO_enrichments_by_orthogroups, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=3, fig.height=5}
###########################################
########### INPUT BACKGROUND ##############
###########################################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"

### Get OG background
all_orthogroups_background = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  .$OG_ID %>%
  unique()

### Get OG_ID - Gene correspondence
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))


###########################################
########### INPUT ANNOTATION ##############
###########################################

OG_annotation_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/GO_transfers/All_version2/GO_annot/Hs2_transfers/orthogroups_from_Hs2-transferred_GO-Bilateria_conserved.txt"
OG_annotation_df = read.delim(OG_annotation_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "GO_ID", "GO_Name"))

### The previous were enichments at the species level
### I am now doing at the gene orthogroups level

###########################################
########### INPUT REG #####################
###########################################

#### Upload REG genes
all_species_reg_genes_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  #Get regulated genes genes
  AS_genes = unique(as.vector(AS_regulated_df$GeneID))
  GE_genes = unique(as.vector(GE_regulated_df$GeneID))
  #Join into a dataframe
  all_species_reg_genes_df = all_species_reg_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Species = rep(species, length(AS_genes)),
                                Reg_type = rep("AS", length(AS_genes)),
                                GeneID = AS_genes)) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Species = rep(species, length(GE_genes)),
                                Reg_type = rep("GE", length(GE_genes)),
                                GeneID = GE_genes))
}

all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_reg_genes_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

### Get groups of orthogroups
OG_with_GE = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "GE") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()
OG_with_AS = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "AS") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()

### Both
GE_AS_OGs = OG_with_GE[OG_with_GE %in% OG_with_AS]
### GE_only
GE_only_OGs = OG_with_GE[!(OG_with_GE %in% GE_AS_OGs)]
### AS_only
AS_only_OGs = OG_with_AS[!(OG_with_AS %in% GE_AS_OGs)]
### NO_reg
NO_reg_OGs = all_orthogroups_background[!(all_orthogroups_background %in% c(GE_AS_OGs, GE_only_OGs, AS_only_OGs))]


###########################################
############ HYPERGEO TEST ################
###########################################

background_counts_df = OG_annotation_df %>%
  ### Supefluous, but just in case
  filter(OG_ID %in% all_orthogroups_background) %>%
  group_by(GO_Name) %>%
  summarize(K = n(), .groups="drop")
  
set.seed(123)
all_hypergeo_OGs_res_df = data.frame()
for (OG_category in c("GE_AS_OGs", "GE_only_OGs", "AS_only_OGs", "NO_reg_OGs")) {
  
  ### Get the vector with the OGs to test
  OG_vector = get(OG_category)
  
  ### Get the OG counts by GO
  OGs_counts_df = OG_annotation_df %>%
  filter(OG_ID %in% OG_vector) %>%
  group_by(GO_Name) %>%
  summarize(k = n(), .groups="drop")
  
  #### Compute hypergeo test
  OG_category_hypergeo_res_df = OGs_counts_df %>%
    left_join(background_counts_df, by="GO_Name") %>%
    mutate(n = length(OG_vector),
           N = length(all_orthogroups_background),
           p0 = K/N,
           p1 = k/n) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    #Perform the hypergeo test
    mutate(pval = phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail = FALSE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Obs_vs_Exp_ratio = p1/p0) %>%
    mutate(OG_category = OG_category)
  
  #### Join to final dataframe
  all_hypergeo_OGs_res_df = all_hypergeo_OGs_res_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(OG_category_hypergeo_res_df)
}

### Save results for Supplementary Table
write.table(all_hypergeo_OGs_res_df, "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/tmp_images/paper_tables/OG_level_GO_enrichments-v1.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

###########################################
############ PROCESS RESULTS ##############
###########################################
    
significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_df = all_hypergeo_OGs_res_df %>% 
  filter(pval <= 0.001, k >= 10, K>=25)

significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_wide_df = significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols="GO_Name", values_from="Obs_vs_Exp_ratio", names_from="OG_category", values_fill=0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("GO_Name")

###########################################
############ PLOT WITH GGPLOT #############
###########################################

### Get orthogroups order for plotting
ph = pheatmap::pheatmap(significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_wide_df,
               clustering_method = "ward.D2",
               silent = TRUE)

row_order = ph$tree_row$order
ordered_rows = rownames(significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_wide_df)[row_order]

significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_plot_input_df = significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_df %>%
  dplyr::select(GO_Name, Obs_vs_Exp_ratio, OG_category) %>%
  mutate(OG_category = factor(OG_category, levels=c("GE_AS_OGs", "GE_only_OGs", "AS_only_OGs", "NO_reg_OGs"))) %>%
  mutate(GO_Name = factor(GO_Name, levels=ordered_rows))

#### PLOT

OG_hypergeo_GO_enrichments_plot = ggplot(data=significant_hypergeo_OGs_res_plot_input_df, aes(x=OG_category, y=GO_Name, fill=OG_category, alpha=Obs_vs_Exp_ratio)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("GE_only_OGs"="brown3", "AS_only_OGs"="dodgerblue3", "GE_AS_OGs"="mediumpurple3", "NO_reg_OGs"="gray55")) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(oob = scales::squish, limits=c(0,3), name="Obs/\nExp:") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        #axis.text.x = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.spacing.y  = unit(1, "cm"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ylab("Significant GO categories") +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "", label=c("GE_only_OGs" = "TS-GE only", "AS_only_OGs"="TS-AS only", "GE_AS_OGs"="Both TS", "NO_reg_OGs" = "No TS")) +
  ### Dummy facet to align the plots later
  facet_wrap(vars(.dummy = "dummy")) +
  guides(fill="none")
  
print(OG_hypergeo_GO_enrichments_plot)
```

<!-- Panel E: Intra-orthogoup feature distributions AS vs GE -->
```{r TS_AS-TS_GE-intra_orthogroups_feature_differences, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
###############################
########## INPUT ##############
###############################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

tot_OGs = length(unique(as.vector(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID)))

geneID_paralog_number_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df  %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  ### I define number of paralogs as the total number of genes from the same species in the same orthogroup
  mutate(Paralog_num = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Paralog_num)

#### Upload TS genes
all_species_reg_genes_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  ### Get regulated genes genes
  AS_genes = unique(as.vector(AS_regulated_df$GeneID))
  GE_genes = unique(as.vector(GE_regulated_df$GeneID))
  ### Join into a dataframe
  all_species_reg_genes_df = all_species_reg_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Species = rep(species, length(AS_genes)),
                                Reg_type = rep("AS", length(AS_genes)),
                                GeneID = AS_genes)) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Species = rep(species, length(GE_genes)),
                                Reg_type = rep("GE", length(GE_genes)),
                                GeneID = GE_genes))
}


#########################################
########## UPLOAD FEATURES ##############
#########################################

#### For each species, upload AS and GE tables
all_species_features_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  for (reg_type in c("GE", "AS")) {
    ### Genomic features
    features_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-gene_length_and_exon_num.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Gene_length", "Exon_num"))
    
    ### Combine dataframes
    reg_type_df = features_df %>%
      mutate(Species = species,
             Reg_type = reg_type) %>%
      left_join(geneID_paralog_number_df, by="GeneID")
    
    all_species_features_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_features_df, reg_type_df)
  }
}

all_species_features_df = all_species_features_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

#################################################
############## JOIN AND FILTER ##################
#################################################

OG_with_GE = all_species_features_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "GE") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()
OG_with_AS = all_species_features_df %>% filter(Reg_type == "AS") %>% .$OG_ID %>% unique()
OG_with_both = OG_with_GE[OG_with_GE %in% OG_with_AS]


#######################################
###### DISTRIBS AT THE OG LEVEL #######
#######################################

shared_OG_features_df = all_species_features_df %>%
  filter(OG_ID %in% OG_with_both) %>%
  #dplyr::select(-Exon_num) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Gene_length) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  #mutate(Gene_lenght_norm = log10(Gene_length)) %>%
  mutate(Exon_num_norm = log10(Exon_num)) %>%
  mutate(Paralog_num_norm = ifelse(Paralog_num >= 5, 5, Paralog_num)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Reg_type) %>%
  summarize(Mean_exon_num_norm = mean(Exon_num_norm, na.rm=TRUE),
  #summarize(Mean_gene_lenght_norm = mean(Gene_lenght_norm, na.rm=TRUE),
            Mean_paralog_num_norm = mean(Paralog_num_norm, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("Mean_exon_num_norm", "Mean_paralog_num_norm"), names_to = "Category", values_to = "Values") %>%
  #pivot_longer(cols=c("Mean_gene_lenght_norm", "Mean_paralog_num_norm"), names_to = "Category", values_to = "Values") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("OG_ID", "Category"), names_from=Reg_type, values_from = "Values")


#######################################
############## PLOT ###################
#######################################

### Get facet limies
facet_limits = shared_OG_features_df %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  group_modify(~{lims = range(c(.x$AS, .x$GE), na.rm=TRUE); tibble(AS=lims, GE=lims)}) %>%
  ungroup()

intra_OG_distribs_plot = ggplot(data=shared_OG_features_df, aes(x=AS, y=GE)) +
  geom_blank(data=facet_limits, aes(x=AS, y=GE), inherit.aes=FALSE) +
  geom_pointdensity(adjust = 1, alpha=0.4) +
  geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, color="firebrick1", size=0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "cividis", name="Density:", breaks=seq(0,600,150)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color="black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        strip.text = element_text(color="black")) +
  facet_wrap(~Category, ncol=2, scale="free", labeller = as_labeller(c("Mean_exon_num_norm" = "Mean log10(exon number)", "Mean_paralog_num_norm"="Mean number of paralogs"))) +
  xlab("TS-AS") +
  ylab("TS-GE")

print(intra_OG_distribs_plot)
```

<!-- Panel AB: Summarized patterns of shared pairwise TS-regulation -->
```{r summarized pairwise_TS_conservation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.height=4, fig.width=10}

######################################
########### INPUT ####################
######################################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))


#### Upload TS genes
all_species_reg_genes_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    mutate(Reg_type = "AS",
           Species = species)
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    mutate(Reg_type = "GE",
           Species = species)

  ### Join into a dataframe
  all_species_reg_genes_df = all_species_reg_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(GE_regulated_df)
}

all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_reg_genes_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

###############################
########## PROCESS ############
###############################

all_TS_OGs_df = data.frame()

for (query_species in c(Vertebrata, Insecta)) {
  print(query_species)
  for (reg_type in c("AS", "GE")) {
    for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
      query_species_OGs = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>%
        filter(Species == query_species,
               Reg_type == reg_type,
               Tissue == tissue) %>%
        .$OG_ID %>%
        unique()
      
      tot_query_species_TS_OGs = length(query_species_OGs)
      if (query_species %in% Vertebrata) {all_target_species = Vertebrata[Vertebrata != query_species]} else {
        all_target_species = Insecta[Insecta != query_species]
      }
      
      for (target_species in all_target_species) {
        target_species_OGs = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>%
          filter(Species == target_species,
                 Reg_type == reg_type,
                 Tissue == tissue,
                 OG_ID %in% query_species_OGs) %>%
          .$OG_ID %>%
          unique()
        
        tot_target_species_TS_OGs = length(target_species_OGs)
        
        ts_OG_df = data.frame(Query_species = query_species,
                              Tissue = tissue,
                              Target_species = target_species,
                              Reg_type = reg_type,
                              Tot_OGs = tot_target_species_TS_OGs,
                              TS_OG_prop = tot_target_species_TS_OGs/tot_query_species_TS_OGs)
        ### Join to final df
        all_TS_OGs_df = all_TS_OGs_df %>%
          dplyr::bind_rows(ts_OG_df)
      }
    }
  }
}

### Compute medians
all_TS_OGs_raw_formatted_df = all_TS_OGs_df %>%
  mutate(Clade = ifelse(Query_species %in% Vertebrata, "Vertebrata", "Insecta")) %>%
  group_by(Reg_type, Tissue, Clade) %>%
  summarize(Median_TS_OG = median(TS_OG_prop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

### Compute ratios between medians of TS-AS and TS-GE in each tissue/Clade
all_TS_OGs_reg_ratios_df = all_TS_OGs_raw_formatted_df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("Clade", "Tissue"), values_from = "Median_TS_OG", names_from = "Reg_type") %>%
  ### Add small value to avoid 0/0 ratios
  mutate(AS = AS+0.0001,
         GE = GE+0.0001) %>%
  ###
  mutate(log2_AS_GE = log2(AS/GE)) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=rev(ordered_tissues)),
         Clade = factor(Clade, levels=c("Vertebrata", "Insecta")))

### Compute ratios between medians of vertebrates and insects in each tissue/reg layer
all_TS_OGs_clade_ratios_df = all_TS_OGs_raw_formatted_df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("Reg_type", "Tissue"), values_from = "Median_TS_OG", names_from = Clade) %>%
  ### Add small value to avoid 0/0 ratios
  mutate(Vertebrata = Vertebrata+0.0001,
         Insecta = Insecta+0.0001) %>%
  ###
  mutate(log2_vertebrata_insecta = log2(Vertebrata/Insecta)) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),
           Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=rev(c("AS", "GE"))))

### Combine the two layers
shared_reg_ratios_combined_df = all_TS_OGs_reg_ratios_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-AS, -GE) %>%
  dplyr::rename("Log2_values"="log2_AS_GE") %>%
  dplyr::rename("Variable"="Clade") %>%
  mutate(Category = "Reg_type") %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_TS_OGs_clade_ratios_df %>%
                    dplyr::select(-Vertebrata, -Insecta) %>%
                    dplyr::rename("Log2_values"="log2_vertebrata_insecta") %>%
                    dplyr::rename("Variable"="Reg_type") %>%
                    mutate(Category = "Clade")) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues)) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels=rev(c("Clade", "Reg_type")))) %>%
```

<!-- Panel C: TS-AS R-conservation across all tissues -->
```{r all_tissues_R-cons_proportions, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=6, fig.height=3}

###########################################
################# INPUT ###################
###########################################


all_tissues_R_conservation_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  print(loop_tissue)
  ##### FIRST DIRECTION
  species_pairs_Rcons_df = vector()
  for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
    ### Check if file exists (it will not exists in case of missing samples for some species)
    species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, loop_tissue, "/Compare_exons_summary_input-", species_pair, ".txt")
    if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
      species_pair_df = read.delim(species_pair_file, header=TRUE)
      ### Compute total number of TS exons to compute the overall proportions of R-conserved
      tot_ts_exons = species_pair_df %>%
        filter(my_class=="gene_status") %>%
        summarize(Tot_ts_exons = sum(freq)) %>%
        .$Tot_ts_exons
      
      filtered_species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
        ### Select the number of R-conserved exons
        filter(category == "reg_exon_orth") %>%
        select(c(category, freq)) %>%
        ### Compute proportions of R-conserved exons
        mutate(percentage = freq/tot_ts_exons) %>%
        mutate(Species_pair = species_pair) %>%
        separate(Species_pair, sep="-", c("Species1", "Species2"), remove=FALSE)
      
      species_pairs_Rcons_df = rbind(species_pairs_Rcons_df, as.data.frame(filtered_species_pair_df))
    }
  }
  
  ### Combine df
  all_directions_df = full_join(species_pairs_Rcons_df, species_pairs_Rcons_df, join_by(Species1==Species1, Species2==Species2, category==category)) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue)
  all_tissues_R_conservation_df = all_tissues_R_conservation_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(all_directions_df)
}


###########################################
################# PROCESS #################
##################################
```

```{r Neural_TS_AS_Rcons_heatmap, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
tissue = "Neural"

if (tissue == "Neural") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#1965B0E6", "Not_conserved"="#1965B033")}
if (tissue == "Muscle") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#4EB265", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#4EB265", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Testis") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#AE76A3", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#AE76A3", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Ovary") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#882E72", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#882E72", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Kidney") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#F7F056", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#F7F056", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Epithelial") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#7BAFDE", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#7BAFDE", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "DigestiveTract") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#F1932D", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#F1932D", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Adipose") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#DC050C", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#DC050C", 0.2))}


###########################################
################# INPUT ###################
###########################################

##### FIRST DIRECTION
species_pairs_Rcons_df = vector()
for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
  ### Check if file exists (it will not exists in case of missing samples for some species)
  species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, tissue, "/Compare_exons_summary_input-", species_pair, ".txt")
  if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
    species_pair_df = read.delim(species_pair_file, header=TRUE)
    ### Compute total number of TS exons to compute the overall proportions of R-conserved
    tot_ts_exons = species_pair_df %>%
      filter(my_class=="gene_status") %>%
      summarize(Tot_ts_exons = sum(freq)) %>%
      .$Tot_ts_exons
    
    filtered_species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
      ### Select the number of R-conserved exons
      filter(category == "reg_exon_orth") %>%
      select(c(category, freq)) %>%
      ### Compute proportions of R-conserved exons
      mutate(percentage = freq/tot_ts_exons) %>%
      mutate(Species_pair = species_pair) %>%
      separate(Species_pair, sep="-", c("Species1", "Species2"), remove=FALSE)
    
    species_pairs_Rcons_df = rbind(species_pairs_Rcons_df, as.data.frame(filtered_species_pair_df))
  }
}

### Combine df
all_directions_df = full_join(species_pairs_Rcons_df, species_pairs_Rcons_df, join_by(Species1==Species1, Species2==Species2, category==category))


###########################################
################# PROCESS #################
###########################################

### Order factors and get missing values
category_df = all_directions_df %>%
  select(-c("freq.x", "freq.y")) %>%
  select(category, Species1, Species2, percentage.x, percentage.y) %>%
    mutate(percentage.diagonal = NA,
    Species1 = factor(Species1, levels = ordered_species_tree),
    #Species2 = factor(Species2, levels = rev(ordered_species_tree))) %>%
    Species2 = factor(Species2, levels = ordered_species_tree)) %>%
  select(-category)

### Set limits for plots
my_limits = c(0, round_up_0.05((max(c(category_df$percentage.x, category_df$percentage.y), na.rm=TRUE))))

### Symmetrize and generate entries for the diagonal
symmetric_df = asymmetrise(category_df, Species1, Species2)
symmetric_df$percentage.diagonal[symmetric_df$Species1==symmetric_df$Species2] = 1.00


###########################################
################# PLOT ####################
###########################################

TS_AS_conservation_heatmap = ggplot(tibble(symmetric_df), aes(x=Species2, y=Species1)) +
  geom_asymmat(aes(fill_tl=percentage.y, fill_br=percentage.x)) +
  scale_fill_br_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), breaks=number_ticks(5), 
                         name=paste0("Prop of ", unname(category_labels["reg_exon_orth"]), " ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " TS-AS:")) +
  scale_fill_tl_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), guide="none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  #ggtitle(paste0(unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " ~ ", unname(category_labels["reg_exon_orth"]), " TS exons")) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Query species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(name="Target species", labels=species_labels)

print(TS_AS_conservation_heatmap)
```

<!-- Panel E: Neural TS_GE R-conservation heatmap -->
```{r Neural_TS_GE_Rcons_heatmap, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=6}

##########################################
############### PRELIMINARY ##############
##########################################

node_species = list(
  Bilateria = Bilateria,
  Euarchontoglires = Euarchontoglires,
  Eutheria = Eutheria,
  Mammalia = Mammalia,
  Amniota = Amniota,
  Tetrapoda = Tetrapoda,
  Euteleostomi = Euteleostomi,
  Vertebrata = Vertebrata,
  Chordata = Chordata,
  Deuterostoma = Deuterostoma,
  Cyclorrapha = Cyclorrapha,
  Diptera = Diptera,
  Panorpidae = Panorpidae,
  Oligoneoptera = Oligoneoptera,
  Holometabola = Holometabola,
  Neoptera = Neoptera,
  Insecta = Insecta,
  Arthropoda = Arthropoda,
  Protostoma = Protostoma,
  Outgroups = Outgroups
)

node_lookup = enframe(node_species, name = "Node", value = "Species") %>%
  unnest_longer(Species)

species_lookup = tibble(Node = ordered_species, Species = ordered_species)

lookup = bind_rows(node_lookup, species_lookup) %>%
  distinct(Node, Species)

##########################################
######## INPUT GAINS/LOSSES ##############
##########################################

### I really need to take into account the losses as well. So:
# 1. Upload the best-TS file
# 2. Upload the gains file
# 3. Select the species within the gains
# 4. Remove the species within the losses (if any)

#### Upload gains info
TS_GE_gains_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  input_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", loop_tissue, "_inferred_gains.tab"), 
                        header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("OG_ID", "Node", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue,
           Inference_type = "Gain")
  ### Join to full dataframe
  TS_GE_gains_df = TS_GE_gains_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
}

#### Upload losses info
TS_GE_losses_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  input_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", loop_tissue, "_inferred_losses.tab"), 
                        header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("OG_ID", "Node", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue,
           Inference_type = "Loss")
  ### Join to full dataframe
  TS_GE_losses_df = TS_GE_losses_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
}

### Expand gain/losses dataframes to include all the species within the nodes
TS_GE_gains_expanded_df = TS_GE_gains_df %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "Node") %>%
  relocate(Species, .after = Node)

TS_GE_losses_expanded_df = TS_GE_losses_df %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "Node") %>%
  relocate(Species, .after = Node)


##########################################
######## INPUT TS NUMBERS ################
##########################################

### All TS-GE genes in each species
all_species_GE_regulated_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### Upload input
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_species_GE_regulated_df = all_species_GE_regulated_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(GE_regulated_df)
}

### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))
### Add gene orthogroup
all_species_GE_regulated_df = all_species_GE_regulated_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

### Numbers of TS-GE genes in each species
all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### Get total number of TS-GE genes in all species
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  ### For each tissue, compute the total number of genes
  for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
    tissue_GE_regulated_df = GE_regulated_df %>%
      filter(grepl(loop_tissue, Tissue)) %>%
      dplyr::select(GeneID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue) %>%
      group_by(Tissue) %>%
      summarize(Tot_TS_GE_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Species = species)
    ### Join to final df
    all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(tissue_GE_regulated_df)
  }
}

##########################################
############### PROCESS ##################
##########################################

### Upload best-TS
all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df = data.frame()


best_TS_OGs_file = paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", tissue, "_specific_OGs.tab")
best_TS_OGs_df = read.delim(best_TS_OGs_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID", "Tau", "Associated_tissue", "Expr_cutoff"))

### Compute total numbers of TS-GE genes in each species
best_TS_OGs_df = best_TS_OGs_df %>%
  ### Add TS_tissue
  mutate(Tissue = tissue) %>%
  ### Filter only actual TS genes
  filter(Tau >= 0.75, grepl(tissue, Associated_tissue), Expr_cutoff=="YES_EXPR") %>%
  ### Select only species within the gains
  dplyr::left_join(TS_GE_gains_expanded_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Species", "Tissue")) %>%
  ### Remove the species with losses
  dplyr::anti_join(TS_GE_losses_expanded_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Species", "Tissue"))

for (query_species in ordered_species) {
  print(query_species)
  for (target_species in ordered_species[ordered_species != query_species]) {
    query_target_best_TS_OGs_df = best_TS_OGs_df %>%
      group_by(OG_ID, Node, Category) %>%
      filter(any(Species == query_species) & 
            any(Species == target_species)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(Species == query_species) %>%
      dplyr::select(OG_ID, Tissue, Species) %>%
      ### Add all tissue-specific genes of the query species
      dplyr::left_join(all_species_GE_regulated_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Tissue", "Species")) %>%
      mutate(Target_species = target_species) %>%
      group_by(Tissue, Species, Target_species) %>%
      summarize(Tot_conserved_TS_genes = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      ### Add original numbers
      dplyr::left_join(all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df, by=c("Tissue", "Species"))
    
    ### Join to final dataframe
    all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(query_target_best_TS_OGs_df)
  }
}


all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_formatted_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df %>%
  mutate(Rcons_prop = Tot_conserved_TS_genes / Tot_TS_GE_genes) %>%
  rename("Query_species" = "Species") %>%
  mutate(Query_species = factor(Query_species, levels=ordered_species_tree),
         Target_species = factor(Target_species, levels=ordered_species_tree))

my_limits = c(0, round_up_0.05(max(all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_formatted_df$Rcons_prop, na.rm=TRUE)))

###########################################
################# PLOT ####################
###########################################
  
TS_GE_conservation_heatmap = ggplot(data=all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_formatted_df, aes(x=Query_species, y=Target_species, fill=Rcons_prop)) +
  geom_tile() +
  #scale_fill_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue])) +
  scale_fill_gradient(limits=c(0,0.6), low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), oob = scales::squish,
                      name=paste0("Prop of R-cons ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " TS-GE:")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  #ggtitle(paste0(unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " ~ ", unname(category_labels["reg_exon_orth"]), " TS genes")) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Query species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(name="Target species", labels=species_labels) +
  coord_fixed()

print(TS_GE_conservation_heatmap)
```

<!-- Panel FG: R-conserved neural TS-AS and TS-GE across clades -->
```{r define_R-conserved_TS_AS, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

################################
######## INPUT #################
################################

### Upload exon orthogroups
exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID

exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) #%>%
  ### Filter out exons with low membership scores
  #filter(Membership_score >= 0.15)

###################################
###### UPLOAD TS-AS INFO ##########
###################################

all_species_AS_types_input_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_AS_types_input_df = all_species_AS_types_input_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD TAU INFO #########
###################################

all_taus_conserved_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  tau_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-tau-all_EX_events.tab")
  tau_df = read.delim(tau_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Tau"))
  ### Filter only for the VastIDs present in the exon orthogroups
  filtered_tau_df = tau_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_taus_conserved_df = all_taus_conserved_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_tau_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD RANKED PSI INFO #####
###################################

all_PSI_ranks_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  PSI_ranks_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-ranked_PSIs-all_EX_events.tab")
  PSI_ranks_df = read.delim(PSI_ranks_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Top_tissue", "PSI", "Rank"))
  filtered_PSI_ranks_df = PSI_ranks_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID & Rank == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(VastID, Top_tissue) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_PSI_ranks_df = all_PSI_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_PSI_ranks_df)
}
    

###################################
###### INTEGRATE TS-AS INFO #######
###################################

### Integrate AS information to the exon orthogrourps
AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df = exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_AS_types_input_df, by=join_by("Species"=="Species", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "VastID"=="EventID")) %>%
  left_join(all_taus_conserved_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  left_join(all_PSI_ranks_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  mutate(AS_type = ifelse(AS_type != "TS_AS", "NO_AS", AS_type))


###################################
###### GET CLADE-SPECIFIC EXOGs ###
###################################

clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = data.frame()
### Cycle on all clades
for (clade in all_clades) {
  ### Isolate species of the clade in question
  clade_species = get(clade)
  ### Select earliest diverging species. If most recent nodes, select both daughter species
  last_species = clade_species[length(clade_species)]
  if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {last_species = clade_species}
  
  ### Select exon orthogroups with Neural TS-AS in that clade
  TS_AS_exon_orthogroups = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    ### Require earliest diverging species to be Neural. Require that none of the species outside the clade to be Neural.
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    ### Require that the earliest diverging species are Neural or Neural-like. Require that NONE of the other species is neural or neural-like.
    filter(
      any((Species %in% last_species & Tissue==tissue) | (Species %in% last_species & Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue), na.rm = TRUE) &
      !any(!(Species %in% clade_species) & (Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ### Select Neural and Neural-like TS-AS exons for the species belonging to each clade
    filter(Species %in% clade_species) %>%
    filter(Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)) %>%
    ### Compute total numbers of Neural exons in each orthogroups
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    summarize(Tot_AS_species = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    ### Require at least 50% of the species to have at least one Neural exons. In case of the earliest diverging nodes, require BOTH species.
    filter(Tot_AS_species >= if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {length(clade_species)} else 
      {0.5 * length(clade_species)}) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    .$ExOG_ID
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  ### The selected ExOG_IDs are considered R-conserved in the relative clade.
  clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(ExOG_ID = TS_AS_exon_orthogroups,
                                Clade = rep(clade, length(TS_AS_exon_orthogroups))))
}


#######################################################
################ ADD EXTRA CATEGORIES #################
#######################################################

### Classify the exon orthogroups containing G-conserved Neural TS-exons that we failed to clearly classify
other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  ### Exclude the classified conserved exons
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% as.vector(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID))) %>%
  ### Only select truly Neural TS-AS exons
  filter(AS_type == "TS_AS", Tissue == tissue) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ### Compute the number of species with Neural TS-AS exons
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
  ### All this sequence of conditions work from the bottom up:
  ### If there are Neural species on both branches that do not respect the criteria for ancestrality (see below): Others
  mutate(Category = "Others-Bilateria") %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Deuterostoma), "Unclear-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Protostoma), "Unclear-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Deuterostoma, "Single_species-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Protostoma, "Single_species-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there are at least one vertebrate, one insects, one vertebrate outgroup and one insect outgroup: ancestral biltateria.
  mutate(Category = ifelse(any(Species %in% Vertebrata) & any(Species %in% Insecta) & any(Species %in% c("Bla", "Sp2")) & any(Species %in% c("Sma", "Obi")) & Tot_TS_species >= 9, "Ancestral-Bilateria", Category)) %>%
  separate(Category, c("Category", "Clade_group"), remove=TRUE, sep="-") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Species) %>%
  distinct()

########################################################
################ CLASSIFY UNCLEAR ONES #################
########################################################

#### I think the unclear cases might be cases of TS loss rather than anything else
### The idea is that if the TS-AS exons only differ for -/+ 3nt, they are likely the same ancestral exon even if their phylogenetic distribution does not truly suppoer that
unclear_conservation_cases_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(Category == "Unclear")
  
#### Select those unclear cases where all TS exons have the same length (-/+3).
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>% 
  inner_join(unclear_conservation_cases_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>% 
  filter(Tissue==tissue) %>% 
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Avg_exon_length = mean(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, exon_length, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  mutate(original_exon_length = exon_length) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(exon_length = {x = sort(unique(exon_length))
      is_chain <- all(diff(x) == 3)
      small_group <- length(x) <= 3
      if (is_chain && small_group) {min(x)} else {exon_length}}) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-original_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  summarize(Number_lengths = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Number_lengths == 1) %>%
  .$ExOG_ID

#### These unclear cases are labelled as conserved, setting their emergence to the LCA of all species with Neural TS-AS exons.
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector) %>%
  ### Filter with the TS requirements
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Clade = find_LCA_clade(unique(Species), clade_list), .groups="drop") #%>%

########################################################
################ UPDATE CLASSIFICATIONS ################
########################################################

### Update previous dataframes to include the new classification
clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df)

other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df$ExOG_ID)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Category == "Unclear", "Others", Category))

########################################################
################ SAVE R-CONS OGs TO FILE ###############
########################################################

Rcons_ExOGs_to_save_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% 
                     filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>% 
                     dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Clade_group) %>% 
                     dplyr::rename("Clade"="Clade_group"))
  
write.table(Rcons_ExOGs_to_save_df, 
            file=paste0("/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/data/TS_AS_gains/", tissue, "-Rcons_ExOGs_by_clade.tab"), 
            sep="\t", quote=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

############################################
######## NUMBERS OF CONSERVED EX_OGs #######
############################################

### Count how many ExOGs per ancestor there are
collapsed_clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  group_by(Clade) %>%
  summarize(Conserved_exon_OGs = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(Clade_group = ifelse(Clade %in% all_clades[1:9], "Vertebrata", "Insecta")) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = match(Clade, all_clades)) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = ifelse(Tree_level >= 10, Tree_level-9, Tree_level)) %>%
  ### Add ancestral exons to this plot (currently they are in the other dataframe)
  dplyr::bind_rows(other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% 
                     group_by(Category) %>%
                     summarize(Conserved_exon_OGs = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
                     filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>%
                     dplyr::select(-Category) %>%
                     mutate(Clade_group = "Bilateria",
                            Clade = "Bilateria",
                            Tree_level = 10)) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = factor(Tree_level, levels=seq(1,10))) %>%
  mutate(Clade = factor(Clade, levels=c(all_clades, "Bilateria"))) %>%
  mutate(Clade_group = factor(Clade_group, levels=c("Vertebrata", "Insecta", "Bilateria"))) %>%
  ### Add conservation category
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Clade %in% c("Bilateria", "Deuterostoma", "Vertebrata", "Protostoma", "Insecta", "Chordata", "Arthropoda"), "Highly_conserved", "Conserved")) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Highly_conserved", "Conserved")))
```

```{r define_R-conserved_TS_GE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}
TS_GE_gains_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", tissue, "_inferred_gains.tab"),

  mutate(Category = ifelse(Clade %in% c("Bilateria", "Deuterostoma", "Vertebrata", "Protostoma", "Insecta", "Chordata", "Arthropoda"), "Highly_conserved", "Conserved")) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Highly_conserved", "Conserved")))
```

```{r all_conservation_groups, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

##################################
########## COLOR SET UP ##########
##################################

if (tissue == "Neural") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"= "#08306B", "Conserved"= "#08519C", "Single_species"="#C6DBEF", "Others"="#F7FBFF")}
if (tissue == "Muscle") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"=  "#00441B", "Conserved"=  "#006D2C", "Single_species"="#E5F5E0", "Others"="#F7FCF5")}
if (tissue == "Testis") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"="#DD3497", "Conserved"=  "#F768A1", "Single_species"="#FDE0DD", "Others"="#FFF7F3")}
if (tissue == "Ovary") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#882E72", "Conserved" = "#A24A8A", "Single_species" = "#D8B4C8", "Others" = "#F4EAF0")}
if (tissue == "Kidney") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#F7F056", "Conserved" = "#FAF27A", "Single_species" = "#FEF7C9", "Others" = "#FFFDEB")}
if (tissue == "Epithelial") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#7BAFDE", "Conserved" = "#9CC3E6", "Single_species" = "#D6E6F4", "Others" = "#F1F6FB")}

my_strip = strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c("TS_AS"="#1C86EE80", "TS_GE"="#CD333380")))
```

```{r compared_TS-AS_exon_lengths_across_tissues_by_species, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}
##################################

### This was generated in the previous chunks 

### Upload all TS-AS gains
all_TS_AS_gains_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  ### Upload
  TS_AS_gains_file = paste0(ts_as_gains_dir, loop_tissue, "-Rcons_ExOGs_by_clade.tab")
  TS_AS_gains_df = read.delim(TS_AS_gains_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("ExOG_ID", "Clade")) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue)
  ### Join to common dataframe
  all_TS_AS_gains_df = all_TS_AS_gains_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(TS_AS_gains_df)
}

### Select TS-AS exons from TS-AS conserved exon orthogroups
all_conserved_TS_AS_exon_lengths_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  ### Select only TS_AS
  filter(AS_type == "TS_AS") %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species, VastID, Tissue, AS_type, exon_length) %>%
  inner_join(all_TS_AS_gains_df,
             by=c("ExOG_ID", "Tissue")) %>%
  ### Generate extra categories
  mutate(Tissue_group = ifelse(Tissue == "Neural", "Neural", "Others"),
         Species_group = ifelse(Species == "Sp2", "Sp2", "Others")) %>%
  group_by(Species, Species_group, Tissue_group) %>%
  summarize(#Mean_exon_length = mean(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE),
            Median_exon_length = median(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Species_group, Tissue_group, Median_exon_length)


formatted_all_conserved_TS_AS_exon_lengths_df = all_conserved_TS_AS_exon_lengths_df %>%
  group_by(Species_group, Species) %>%
  mutate(Normalized_length = (Median_exon_length / max(Median_exon_length))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Clade_group = case_when(Species %in% Deuterostoma ~ "Vertebrata_branch",
                                 Species %in% Protostoma ~ "Insecta_branch",
                                 TRUE ~ "Outgroups")) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species),
         Tissue_group = factor(Tissue_group, levels=c("Neural", "Others")),
         Species_group = factor(Species_group, levels=c("Sp2", "Others")),
         Clade_group = factor(Clade_group, levels=rev(c("Vertebrata_branch", "Insecta_branch"))))


##################################
######### PLOT ###################
##################################

        legend.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),

        ) +

  scale_y_continuous(name = "Median exon length of conserved TS-AS exons", breaks = number_ticks(6))

print(all_conserved_TS_AS_exon_lengths_plots)
```
