<!-- Panel B: Conservation and convergence patterns by SPECIES and exon -->
```{r conservation_convergence_by_species-v1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
#### IMPORTANT: This relies on the inputs generated for panel C

#### If the exons are in the conserved or highly conserved exon orthogroups: conserved
#### All other exons:
### If the exons are in sub-exon orthogroups or BH with other Neural exons: convergence type I
### If the exon is in a gene orthogroup with other Neural exons: convergence type II
### Otherwise: the exon is new!

#############################
######## INPUT ##############
#############################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

### Select only Conserved exon orthogroups
conserved_exon_orthogroups_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% c(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID, 
                        other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>% 
                          .$ExOG_ID)) %>%
  filter(Tissue == tissue)

### BH
### Build vastID file

#### Upoload files with all vastIDs of TS-AS exons. It contains also vastID of overlapping exons. We would get some missing results otherwise
all_vastIDs_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  vast_ID_file = paste0(ts_info_file_dir, species, "-bilaterian_conserved-ts_info.tab")
  vast_ID_df = read.delim(vast_ID_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    filter(Direction == "UP" &
             grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_vastIDs_df = all_vastIDs_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(vast_ID_df)
}

### Select all neural exons. This dataframe will be needed to derive the convergence type II statistics.
all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

#############
#############

### I am adding the original exon clusters
### Upload not-reclustered exon orthogroups
original_exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_clusters-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID

original_exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(original_exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species, GeneID, Coordinate) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID"="ExOG_ID")

#############
#############

convergence_type_I_df = data.frame()
### Cycle on all species_pairs
for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
  species_query = sub("-.*", "", species_pair)
  
  ### Check if the relative file exists from the compare exons exists (it will be missing for species without samples of the selected tissue)
  ### IMPORTANT: consider here to do a run with the clustered, rather than the reclustered.
  ### Or: add the original exon cluster for both entries. If these are identical, the label should be set to UNCLEAR or something (if not conserved).
  
  species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, tissue, "/OrthoGenes_with_reg_exons-", species_pair, ".tab")
  ### If file exists and it's not empty
  if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
    species_pair_df = read_tsv(species_pair_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      ### Add original ExOG_ID for both coordinates
      left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_1"=="Species", "GeneID_1"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_1"=="Coordinate")) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_1"="Original_ExOG_ID") %>%
      left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_2"=="Species", "GeneID_2"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_2"=="Coordinate")) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_2"="Original_ExOG_ID")
    
    if (nrow(species_pair_df) > 0) {
      species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
        ### select best-hit of any kind. This should indicate Neural TS-AS exons that do not end up in the same exon orthogroup but indeed fall in the same intron position.
        filter(grepl("BEST_HIT", CONSERV_CALL) | Original_ExOG_ID_1 == Original_ExOG_ID_2) %>%
        ### Select relevant fields
        dplyr::select(Ex_cluster_1, GeneID_1, Exon_coord_1, Species_1, Species_2, Ex_cluster_2, CONSERV_CALL) %>%
        dplyr::rename("ExOG_ID"="Ex_cluster_1",
                      "ExOG_ID_target"="Ex_cluster_2",
                      "GeneID"="GeneID_1",
                      "Coordinate"="Exon_coord_1",
                      "Species"="Species_1",
                      "Species_target"="Species_2") %>%
        ### Add vastID
        left_join(all_vastIDs_df, by=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "Species"))
      
      ### Join to dataframe
      convergence_type_I_df = convergence_type_I_df %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(species_pair_df)
    }
  }
}

### This contains all gene orthogroups where there are at least 2 Neural exons.
### If only one neural exons, they should be classified as novel
convergence_type_II_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  inner_join(all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
               filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)), by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(OG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
  filter(Tot_TS_species > 1)

#######################################################
###### ASSIGN CONSERVATION LABEL ######################
#######################################################

### There is priority in the conservation labels: Conserved, Convergent type I, Convergent type II, New
all_classified_ts_exons_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
  ### Add gene orthogroup ID
  left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = "New") %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(OG_ID %in% convergence_type_II_df$OG_ID, "Convergent_type_II", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% convergence_type_I_df$VastID, "Convergent_type_I", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% conserved_exon_orthogroups_df$VastID, "Conserved", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species),
         Evo_category = factor(Evo_category, levels=rev(c("Conserved", "Convergent_type_I", "Convergent_type_II", "New"))))
  
#############################
######### PLOT ##############
#############################

evo_classified_ts_exons_plot = ggplot(data=all_classified_ts_exons_df, aes(x=Species, fill=Evo_category)) +
  geom_bar(alpha=0.7, stat="count", position=position_fill(), color="white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(direction=-1, name="Conservation\ncategory:", labels=c("Convergent_type_I"="Convergent\ntype_I", "Convergent_type_II"="Convergent\ntype_II")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  #ggtitle(tissue) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=species_labels, name="") +
  scale_y_continuous(name=paste0("Proportions of ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " TS exons"))

print(evo_classified_ts_exons_plot)
```

<!-- Panel C: Number of convergence TS-AS events by OG_ID -->
```{r TS_AS_conservation_convergence_by_OG_ID, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

### Count the number of conserved TS-AS exon orthogroups
### Upload all TS-AS gains
tissue_TS_AS_gains_file = paste0(ts_as_gains_dir, tissue, "-Rcons_ExOGs_by_clade.tab")
tissue_TS_AS_gains_df = read.delim(tissue_TS_AS_gains_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("ExOG_ID", "Clade")) %>%
  mutate(OG_ID = sub("\\..*", "", ExOG_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(OG_ID, ExOG_ID) %>%
  ### Get common name to combine dataframe
  dplyr::rename("Entity"="ExOG_ID") %>%
  distinct()

### Use the all classified exons to select the ones that are NOT in these exon orthogroups
conserved_TS_AS_exons_vector = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(AS_type == "TS_AS") %>%
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% tissue_TS_AS_gains_df$Entity) %>%
  .$VastID

non_conserved_TS_AS_exons_df = all_classified_ts_exons_df %>%
  filter(!(EventID %in% conserved_TS_AS_exons_vector)) %>%
  dplyr::select(OG_ID, EventID) %>%
  ### Get common name to combine dataframe
  dplyr::rename("Entity"="EventID")

### Combine the dataframes
all_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df = tissue_TS_AS_gains_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(non_conserved_TS_AS_exons_df) %>%
  group_by(OG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Tot_recurrent_gains = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Tot_recurrent_gains))

gene_orthogroups_ranks = all_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df %>% .$OG_ID

capped_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df = all_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  mutate(Tot_recurrent_gains = ifelse(Tot_recurrent_gains >= 15, 15, Tot_recurrent_gains)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_recurrent_gains >= 2, "Recurrent", "Novel")) %>%
  mutate(OG_ID = factor(OG_ID, levels=gene_orthogroups_ranks),
         Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Recurrent", "Novel")))

#############################
######### PLOT ##############
#############################

### Count tot gene orthogroups
tot_gene_orthogroups = length(unique(capped_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))
conservation_convergence_colors = viridisLite::viridis(4)[c(3, 4)]

TS_AS_OG_level_overview_plot = ggplot(data=capped_TS_AS_gains_by_gene_orthogroups_df, aes(x=OG_ID, y=Tot_recurrent_gains, fill=Category, color=Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = tot_gene_orthogroups*0.5, y = 14, label = paste0("Number of gene\northogroups: ", tot_gene_orthogroups), hjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Recurrence\nstatus:", values = conservation_convergence_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(name="Recurrence\nstatus:", values = conservation_convergence_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      #legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(name="Number of recurrent TS-AS gains", breaks = seq(1,15), limits=c(0,15), labels=c(as.character(seq(1,14)), "≥ 15")) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Gene orthogroup")

print(TS_AS_OG_level_overview_plot)
```

<!-- Panel E: Saturation of convergence type II -->
```{r saturation_of_OG_with_TS-AS_exons, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
# The tissue variable is still being defined in the first chunck relative to this Figure

########################################
############## INPUT ###################
########################################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

### Upload exon orthogroups
exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID
exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length"))

for (tissue in tissue) {
  print(tissue)
### Upload reference TS-AS exons
reference_TS_AS_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  ### Upload all TS-AS events within bilaterian-conserved genes by species
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    #### Only selected tissue
    filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  reference_TS_AS_df = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

#### Collapse: if TS exons belong to the same ExOG_ID, only select one
temporary_df = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  left_join(exon_orthogroups_df %>% dplyr::select("VastID", "GeneID", "Species", "ExOG_ID"), by=join_by("EventID"=="VastID", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "Species"=="Species"))

processed_reference_TS_AS_df = bind_rows(temporary_df  %>% filter(is.na(ExOG_ID)),
                                         temporary_df  %>% 
                                           filter(!is.na(ExOG_ID)) %>% 
                                           distinct(ExOG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE))

#### Get numbers to filter the randomizations
randomized_numbers_df = processed_reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(Tot_TS_events = n(), .groups = "drop")

### Get number of affected gene orthogroups in the reference set
TS_OGs_number_reference = processed_reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  .$OG_ID %>%
  unique() %>%
  length()

#### Upload files with randomized TS-AS
all_rand_rounds_df = data.frame()
for (rand_round in seq(1,10)) {
  print(rand_round)
  rand_round_df = data.frame()
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    tot_events = randomized_numbers_df %>% filter(Species == species) %>% .$Tot_TS_events
    if (length(tot_events) > 0) {
      ### Upload TS-AS per species and randomized
      input_file = paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/randomization_", rand_round, "/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab")
      input_df = read.delim(input_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>% 
        filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
        slice_sample(n = tot_events) %>%
        mutate(Species = species,
               Rand_round = rand_round) 
      ### Add to rand round df
      rand_round_df = rand_round_df %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
    }
  }
  
  #### Add gene orthogroups and count
  rand_round_df = rand_round_df %>%
    left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  all_rand_rounds_df = all_rand_rounds_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(rand_round_df)
}

#########################################
############### CUM DISTRIBS RAND #######
#########################################

rand_cumulative_distribs_df = data.frame()

for (rand_round in seq(1,10)) {
  initialized_OG_vector = vector()
  selected_rand_rounds_df = all_rand_rounds_df %>%
    filter(Rand_round == rand_round)
  
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    species_OG_vector = selected_rand_rounds_df %>%
      filter(Species == species) %>%
      dplyr::select(OG_ID)%>%
     .$OG_ID %>%
      unique()
    
    ### Compute total numbers of orthogrorups
    extra_TS_AS_OGs = unique(species_OG_vector[!(species_OG_vector  %in% initialized_OG_vector)])
    
    rand_cumulative_distribs_df = rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Category = paste0("Randomization_", rand_round),
                                  Species = species,
                                  Tot_TS_OGs = length(extra_TS_AS_OGs)))
    
    ### Update vector
    initialized_OG_vector = c(initialized_OG_vector, extra_TS_AS_OGs)
    }
}

complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df = rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>% 
  group_by(Category) %>%
  mutate(cum_Tot = cumsum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac = cum_Tot / sum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac_all = cum_Tot /  length(unique(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species))

#########################################
############### CUM DISTRIBS REF ########
#########################################

ref_cumulative_distribs_df = data.frame()
initialized_OG_vector = vector()

for (species in ordered_species) {
  species_OG_vector = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
    left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df , by=c("GeneID", "Species")) %>%
    filter(Species == species) %>%
    dplyr::select(OG_ID)%>%
   .$OG_ID %>%
    unique()
  
  ### Compute total numbers of orthogrorups
  extra_TS_AS_OGs = unique(species_OG_vector[!(species_OG_vector  %in% initialized_OG_vector)])
  
  ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Category = "Reference",
                                Species = species,
                                Tot_TS_OGs = length(extra_TS_AS_OGs)))
  
  ### Update vector
  initialized_OG_vector = c(initialized_OG_vector, extra_TS_AS_OGs)
}

complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>% 
  mutate(cum_Tot = cumsum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac = cum_Tot / sum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac_all = cum_Tot /  length(unique(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species)) %>%
  mutate(Group = "All")

#########################################
############### COMPUTE SATURATION ######
#########################################

### This is the curve: y=a(1−e−bx)
########################
####### REFERENCE ######
########################

### Input
df = complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df

### Add difference in fraction
df$delta_frac_all = c(NA, diff(df$cum_frac_all))
df$x = seq_len(nrow(df))

### Fit model
fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ a * (1 - exp(-b * x)),
          data = df,
          start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))

# fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ (a * x) / (b + x),
#           data = df,
#           start = list(a = 1, b = 5))


### Predicted maximum achievable fraction
ref_asymtote = round(coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)
#If ≈ 0.95–1.0 → essentially saturate. 0.88: we reached 88% of the predicted value
ref_saturation = round(tail(df$cum_frac_all, 1) / coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)

### The remaining cumulative fraction yet to be discovered is ~12% of the model’s predicted total.
epsilon <- 0.005  # 0.5%
k = 5
ref_saturation_reached = all(tail(df$delta_frac_all, k) < epsilon)

#############################
####### RANDOMIZATIONS ######
#############################

### Input
df = complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(cum_frac_all = mean(cum_frac_all, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

### Add difference in fraction
df$delta_frac_all = c(NA, diff(df$cum_frac_all))
df$x = seq_len(nrow(df))

### Fit model
fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ a * (1 - exp(-b * x)),
          data = df,
          start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))

# fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ (a * x) / (b + x),
#           data = df,
#           start = list(a = 1, b = 5))


### Predicted maximum achievable fraction
rand_asymtote = round(coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)
#If ≈ 0.95–1.0 → essentially saturate. 0.88: we reached 88% of the predicted value
rand_saturation = round(tail(df$cum_frac_all, 1) / coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)

### The remaining cumulative fraction yet to be discovered is ~12% of the model’s predicted total.
epsilon <- 0.005  # 0.5%
k = 5
rand_saturation_reached = all(tail(df$delta_frac_all, k) < epsilon)

#########################################
############### PLOT ####################
#########################################

completed_cumulative_distribs_plot = ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all), color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), size=3) +
  geom_line(data=complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all, group=Group), color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue])) +
  geom_jitter(data=complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all), alpha=0.5, color="dimgray", fill="dimgray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=ref_asymtote, color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=rand_asymtote, color="dimgray", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(x=20, y=1),
            label=paste0("TS asymptote: ", ref_asymtote, "\nTS saturation: ", ref_saturation), 
            color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), hjust=1, vjust=1, size=4) +
    geom_text(aes(x=20, y=0.8),
            label=paste0("Rand asymptote: ", rand_asymtote, "\nRand saturation: ", rand_saturation), 
            color="dimgray", hjust=1, vjust=1, size=4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
         axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5)) +
  #ggtitle(tissue) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(paste0("Prop of gene OGs with ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), "TS-AS exons"), limits=c(0,1))

print(completed_cumulative_distribs_plot)
}
```

```{r saturation_of_OG_with_TS-AS_exons, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    species_OG_vector = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
      left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df , by=c("GeneID", "Species")) %>%
      filter(Species == species) %>%
      dplyr::select(OG_ID)%>%
     .$OG_ID %>%
      unique()
    
    ### Compute total numbers of orthogrorups
    extra_TS_AS_OGs = unique(species_OG_vector[!(species_OG_vector  %in% initialized_OG_vector)])
    
    ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Category = "Reference",
                                  Species = species,
                                  Tot_TS_OGs = length(extra_TS_AS_OGs)))
    
    ### Update vector
    initialized_OG_vector = c(initialized_OG_vector, extra_TS_AS_OGs)
  }
  
  complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>% 
    mutate(cum_Tot = cumsum(Tot_TS_OGs),
           cum_frac = cum_Tot / sum(Tot_TS_OGs),
           cum_frac_all = cum_Tot / length(unique(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species)) %>%
    mutate(Group = "All")
  
  selected_cumulative_values_df = complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    filter(cum_frac == max(cum_frac)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue)
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  all_selected_cumulative_values_df = all_selected_cumulative_values_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(selected_cumulative_values_df)
}

#########################################
############### FORMAT ##################
#########################################

formatted_all_selected_cumulative_values_df = all_selected_cumulative_values_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Category, Tissue, cum_frac_all) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Category == "Reference", Tissue, "Randomization")) %>%
  mutate(General_category = ifelse(Category == "Randomization", Category, "Reference")) %>%
  group_by(Category, General_category, Tissue) %>%
  summarize(Prop_of_TS_AS_OGs = median(cum_frac_all, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=rev(ordered_tissues)),
         General_category = factor(General_category, levels=c("Reference", "Randomization")))

#########################################
############### PLOT ####################
#########################################

all_tissues_cumulative_summary_plot = ggplot(data=formatted_all_selected_cumulative_values_df, aes(x=Prop_of_TS_AS_OGs, y=Tissue, shape=General_category, color=Tissue)) +
  geom_line(aes(group=Tissue), size=0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha=1, size=5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=tissue_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c("Reference"=16, "Randomization"=15), labels=c("Reference"="TS","Randomization"="Randomizations"), name="Category:") +
  #scale_size_manual(values=c("Reference"=4, "Randomization"=4)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color="black")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = tissue_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Prop of gene OGs with TS-AS exons")

print(all_tissues_cumulative_summary_plot)
```

```{r spg_mic_KO_gravitax_results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}
##################################

spg_climbing_plot = ggplot(plot_df,
  aes(x = time, y = avg, color = group, group = group)) +

    breaks = c("spg mic-KO_m", "spg mic-KO_f", "CantonS_m", "CantonS_f"),
    labels = c("spg mic-KO  m", "spg mic-KO  f", "CantonS  m", "CantonS  f")) +
```

<!-- Panel I: Percentage survival of fly spg-mic KO-->
```{r spg_mic_KO_survival_results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

##################################
######### INPUT ##################
##################################

# time in days
# event 1=died, 0=escaped/lost
# Mutant 0=CantonS 1=spg
# Female 0=male 1=female

input_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/data/fly_data_antonio/Survival_spg.txt"
input_df = read.delim(input_file, header=TRUE)

processed_input_df = input_df %>%
  mutate(strain = factor(Mutant, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("spg mic-KO", "CantonS")))

### Fit Kaplan-Meier curves
survival_fit = survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ strain, data = processed_input_df)
summary_survival_fit = summary(survival_fit)

kaplan_mayer_df <- tibble(
  time   = summary_survival_fit$time,
  surv   = summary_survival_fit$surv * 100,
  strain = sub("strain=", "", summary_survival_fit$strata)) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(time = 0, 
                   surv = 100, 
                   strain = levels(processed_input_df$strain)))

### Log-rank test
long_rank_test <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ strain, data = processed_input_df)
pvalue  <- pchisq(long_rank_test$chisq, df = length(long_rank_test$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

pvalue_txt <- if (pvalue < 0.0001) "p < 0.0001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pvalue, 2))

##################################
######### PLOT ##################
##################################

spg_kaplan_mayer_plot = ggplot(kaplan_mayer_df, aes(time, surv, color = strain)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1, y = 15, label = pvalue_txt, hjust = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("spg mic-KO" = "brown3", "CantonS" = "dimgray"), breaks = c("spg mic-KO", "CantonS"), labels = expression(italic(spg)~"mic-KO", "CantonS")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50), ylim = c(-5, 105)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Survival (%)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text()
  )

print(spg_kaplan_mayer_plot)
```

```{r TS_AS_TS_GE_over_all_protein_coding, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}
######################################################
##################### INPUTS #########################
######################################################

#################################
######### REG GENES #############
#################################

### The input for the AS-regulated genes has already been filtered for genes containing UP exons
### The inputs have already been filtered for bilaterian-conserved genes only
all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df = data.frame()

for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    #Upload inputs
    AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue))
    GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue))
    
    #Get regulated genes
    AS_genes = unique(as.vector(AS_regulated_df$GeneID))
    GE_genes = unique(as.vector(GE_regulated_df$GeneID))
    #Get total number of genes
    tot_AS_genes = length(AS_genes)
    tot_GE_genes = length(GE_genes)
    #Combine into a unique dataframe (this is different frorm the thesis)
    species_df = data.frame(Species = species,
                            Tissue = tissue,
                            AS = tot_AS_genes,
                            GE = tot_GE_genes)
    #Append to final dataframe
    all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df, species_df)
  }
}

### Format dataframe
all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_long_df = all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("AS", "GE"), names_to="Reg_type", values_to="Tot_genes") %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),
         Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(ordered_species)),
         Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("AS", "GE")))


#################################
######### BACKGROUNDS ###########
#################################

gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_backgrounds_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-OG_ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(Tot_conserved_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")


#################################
############# COMBINED ##########
#################################

combined_df = all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_long_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_backgrounds_df, by="Species") %>%
  group_by(Species, Tot_conserved_genes) %>%
  summarize(Tot_reg_genes = sum(Tot_genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Reg_prop = Tot_reg_genes/Tot_conserved_genes) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(ordered_species))) %>%
  mutate(Category = "Reg_genes_prop")

#################################
############# PLOT ##############
#################################

TS_reg_proportions_plot = ggplot(data=combined_df, aes(x=Category, y=Species, fill=Reg_prop)) +
  geom_tile(color="black") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("gray88", "gray65", "black"), name="Proportion\nof TS\ngenes:") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color="black")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels=species_labels) +
  xlab("All tissues")

print(TS_reg_proportions_plot)
```

```{r TS_AS-TS_GE_genes_ratio_by_tissue, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
#################################

### The input for the AS-regulated genes has already been filtered for genes containing UP exons

all_species_all_tissues_regulated_genes_df = data.frame()
```

```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-all_features_comparisons_vs_BG, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=13.5, fig.height=18}

##########################################
########### INPUT FOR PARALOGS ###########
##########################################

### Number of paralogs for all bilaterian conserved genes
bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df = read.delim(paste0(home, "projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"),
                                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

geneID_paralog_number_df = bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  ### I define number of paralogs as the total number of genes from the same species in the same orthogroup
  mutate(Paralog_num = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Paralog_num)


##########################################
########### REFERENCE INPUTS #############
##########################################

#### For each species, upload AS and GE tables
all_species_features_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  for (reg_type in c("GE", "AS")) {
    ### Genomic features
    features_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-gene_length_and_exon_num.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Gene_length", "Exon_num"))
    ### Sequence similarity
    seq_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_sequence_similarities.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Seq_sim"))
    ### Expression similarity
    expr_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_expression_similarities.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Expr_sim"))
    ### Intergenic distances
    int_dist_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-intergenic_distances.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Int_dist"))
    ### Domain number
    domain_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-total_dom_num.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dom_num"))
    ### Disordered rates
    dis_rate_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_dis_rate.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dis_rate"))
    ### Combine dataframes
    reg_type_df = features_df %>%
      mutate(Species = species,
             Reg_type = reg_type) %>%
      left_join(geneID_paralog_number_df, by="GeneID") %>%
      left_join(seq_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      left_join(expr_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      left_join(int_dist_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      left_join(domain_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
      left_join(dis_rate_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
    
    all_species_features_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_features_df, reg_type_df)
  }
}

##########################################
########### BACKGROUND INPUTS ############
##########################################

all_species_background_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
    ### Genomic features
    features_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-gene_length_and_exon_num.tab"), 
                               header=TRUE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Gene_length", "Exon_num"))
    ### Sequence similarity
    seq_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-average_sequence_similarities.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Seq_sim"))
    ### Expression similarity
    expr_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-average_expression_similarities.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Expr_sim"))
    ### Intergenic distances
    int_dist_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-intergenic_distances.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Int_dist"))
    ### Domain number
    domain_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-total_dom_num.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Dom_num"))
    ### Disordered rates
    dis_rate_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", species, "-all_genes-average_dis_rate.tab"), 
                                       header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Dis_rate"))
    ### Combine dataframes
    background_df = features_df %>%
      mutate(Species = species,
             Reg_type = "BG") %>%
      left_join(geneID_paralog_number_df, by="GeneID") %>%
      left_join(seq_sim_df, by=c("GeneID")) %>%
      left_join(expr_sim_df, by=c("GeneID")) %>%
      left_join(int_dist_df, by=c("GeneID")) %>%
      left_join(domain_df, by=c("GeneID")) %>%
      left_join(dis_rate_df, by=c("GeneID")) %>%
      ### Remove genes that are either TS-AS or TS-GE
      filter(!(GeneID %in% as.vector(all_species_features_df$GeneID)))
      
    all_species_background_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_background_df, background_df)
}


##########################################
######### COMBINE INPUTS #################
##########################################

### Get background values
all_species_background_formatted_df = all_species_background_df %>%
  ### Make sure only other ancestral bilaterian genes are in the background
  filter(GeneID %in% bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df$GeneID) %>%
  ###
  mutate(Dom_num = Dom_num / Gene_length) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Paralog_num", "Seq_sim", "Expr_sim", "Int_dist", "Dom_num", "Dis_rate"), names_to="Feature", values_to="Values") %>%
  group_by(Species, Reg_type, Feature) %>%
  summarize(Mean_value = mean(Values, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("Species", "Feature"), names_from=Reg_type, values_from=Mean_value)

### Get foreground values
all_species_features_formatted_df = all_species_features_df %>%
  mutate(Dom_num = Dom_num / Gene_length) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Paralog_num", "Seq_sim", "Expr_sim", "Int_dist", "Dom_num", "Dis_rate"), names_to="Feature", values_to="Values") %>%
  group_by(Species, Reg_type, Tissue, Feature) %>%
  summarize(Mean_value = mean(Values, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("Species", "Tissue", "Feature"), names_from=Reg_type, values_from=Mean_value) %>%
  left_join(all_species_background_formatted_df, by=c("Species", "Feature")) %>%
  #### Compute zscore
  pivot_longer(cols=c("AS", "GE", "BG"), names_to="Reg_type", values_to="Values") %>%
  group_by(Species, Tissue, Feature) %>%
  mutate(Zscore = (Values - mean(Values, na.rm=TRUE))/sd(Values, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(ordered_species))) %>%
  mutate(Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("AS", "BG", "GE"))) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=c(ordered_tissues))) %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels=c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Expr_sim", "Dis_rate", "Seq_sim", "Int_dist", "Paralog_num", "Dom_num")))

##########################################
################ PLOT ####################
##########################################

all_feature_heatmaps = list()
i = 1
for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  all_species_normalized_features_heatmap = ggplot(data=subset(all_species_features_formatted_df, Tissue==tissue), aes(x=Reg_type, y=Species, fill=Zscore)) +
    geom_tile(color=NA, alpha=0.8) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "mediumpurple3", high="lightgoldenrod2", mid = "white", midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish, na.value = "gray77", name="Norm\nfeature:") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
          strip.background.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=10),
          legend.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", size=9),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    scale_x_discrete(name="TS type", labels=c("AS"="TS-AS", "GE"="TS-GE")) +
    scale_y_discrete(name="Species", labels=species_labels) +
    ggtitle(unname(tissue_labels[tissue])) +
    facet_wrap(~ Feature, labeller = as_labeller(feature_labels), ncol=8)
  
  #print(all_species_normalized_features_heatmap)
  ### Add to plot list
  all_feature_heatmaps[[i]] = all_species_normalized_features_heatmap
  i = i+1
}

all_features_heatmaps_plots = wrap_plots(all_feature_heatmaps, ncol = 2, nrow = 4) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

print(all_features_heatmaps_plots)

# dev.off()
```

```{r pairwise_shared_TS_conservation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
    mutate(Reg_type = "AS",
           Species = species)
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    mutate(Reg_type = "GE",
           Species = species)

  ### Join into a dataframe
  all_species_reg_genes_df = all_species_reg_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(GE_regulated_df)
}

all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_reg_genes_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

###############################
########## PROCESS ############
###############################

all_TS_OGs_df = data.frame()

for (query_species in c(Vertebrata, Insecta)) {
  print(query_species)
  for (reg_type in c("AS", "GE")) {
    for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
      query_species_OGs = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>%
        filter(Species == query_species,
               Reg_type == reg_type,
               Tissue == tissue) %>%
        .$OG_ID %>%
        unique()
      
      tot_query_species_TS_OGs = length(query_species_OGs)
      if (query_species %in% Vertebrata) {all_target_species = Vertebrata[Vertebrata != query_species]} else {
        all_target_species = Insecta[Insecta != query_species]
      }
      
      for (target_species in all_target_species) {
        target_species_OGs = all_species_gene_orthogroups_reg_annot_df %>%
          filter(Species == target_species,
                 Reg_type == reg_type,
                 Tissue == tissue,
                 OG_ID %in% query_species_OGs) %>%
          .$OG_ID %>%
          unique()
        
        tot_target_species_TS_OGs = length(target_species_OGs)
        
        ts_OG_df = data.frame(Query_species = query_species,
                              Tissue = tissue,
                              Target_species = target_species,
                              Reg_type = reg_type,
                              Tot_OGs = tot_target_species_TS_OGs,
                              TS_OG_prop = tot_target_species_TS_OGs/tot_query_species_TS_OGs)
        ### Join to final df
        all_TS_OGs_df = all_TS_OGs_df %>%
          dplyr::bind_rows(ts_OG_df)
      }
    }
  }
}

all_TS_OGs_formatted_df = all_TS_OGs_df %>%
  mutate(Clade = ifelse(Query_species %in% Vertebrata, "Vertebrata", "Insecta")) %>%
  mutate(Query_species = factor(Query_species, levels=ordered_species),
         Target_species = factor(Target_species, levels=ordered_species),
         Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),
         Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("AS", "GE")),
         Clade = factor(Clade, levels=c("Vertebrata", "Insecta"))) %>%
  unite("Reg_type_tissue", c("Reg_type", "Tissue", "Query_species"), sep="_", remove=FALSE)

###############################
############ PLOT #############
###############################

TS_conservation_boxplot = ggplot(data=all_TS_OGs_formatted_df, aes(y=TS_OG_prop, x=Tissue, color=Query_species, fill=Query_species, shape=Target_species, group=Tissue)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, size=1.2) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="white", color="black", alpha=0.5, stroke=0.5, outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=species_colors, name="Query species:", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=species_colors, name="Query species:", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=species_shapes, name="Target species:", labels=species_labels) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0.5, b = 0.5)),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size =  unit(0.7, "lines")) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~Clade+Reg_type, ncol=2, labeller=as_labeller(c("AS"="TS-AS", "GE"="TS-GE", "Vertebrata"="Vertebrata", "Insecta"="Insecta"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=tissue_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(name="Proportion of evolutionayr shared TS") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), order=2),
         fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), order=2),
         shape=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, color="black", alpha=1)))

print(TS_conservation_boxplot)
```

```{r EDF_TS_AS_Rcons_heatmap, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
tissue = "Testis"

if (tissue == "Neural") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#1965B0E6", "Not_conserved"="#1965B033")}
if (tissue == "Muscle") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#4EB265", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#4EB265", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Testis") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#AE76A3", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#AE76A3", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Ovary") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#882E72", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#882E72", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Kidney") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#F7F056", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#F7F056", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Epithelial") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#7BAFDE", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#7BAFDE", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "DigestiveTract") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#F1932D", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#F1932D", 0.2))}
if (tissue == "Adipose") {G_cons_colors = c("G-conserved"="#DC050C", "Not_conserved"=alpha("#DC050C", 0.2))}


###########################################
################# INPUT ###################
###########################################

##### FIRST DIRECTION
species_pairs_Rcons_df = vector()
for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
  ### Check if file exists (it will not exists in case of missing samples for some species)
  species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, tissue, "/Compare_exons_summary_input-", species_pair, ".txt")
  if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
    species_pair_df = read.delim(species_pair_file, header=TRUE)
    ### Compute total number of TS exons to compute the overall proportions of R-conserved
    tot_ts_exons = species_pair_df %>%
      filter(my_class=="gene_status") %>%
      summarize(Tot_ts_exons = sum(freq)) %>%
      .$Tot_ts_exons
    
    filtered_species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
      ### Select the number of R-conserved exons
      filter(category == "reg_exon_orth") %>%
      select(c(category, freq)) %>%
      ### Compute proportions of R-conserved exons
      mutate(percentage = freq/tot_ts_exons) %>%
      mutate(Species_pair = species_pair) %>%
      separate(Species_pair, sep="-", c("Species1", "Species2"), remove=FALSE)
    
    species_pairs_Rcons_df = rbind(species_pairs_Rcons_df, as.data.frame(filtered_species_pair_df))
  }
}

### Combine df
all_directions_df = full_join(species_pairs_Rcons_df, species_pairs_Rcons_df, join_by(Species1==Species1, Species2==Species2, category==category))


###########################################
################# PROCESS #################
###########################################

### Order factors and get missing values
category_df = all_directions_df %>%
  select(-c("freq.x", "freq.y")) %>%
  select(category, Species1, Species2, percentage.x, percentage.y) %>%
    mutate(percentage.diagonal = NA,
    Species1 = factor(Species1, levels = ordered_species_tree),
    #Species2 = factor(Species2, levels = rev(ordered_species_tree))) %>%
    Species2 = factor(Species2, levels = ordered_species_tree)) %>%
  select(-category)

### Set limits for plots
my_limits = c(0, round_up_0.05((max(c(category_df$percentage.x, category_df$percentage.y), na.rm=TRUE))))

### Symmetrize and generate entries for the diagonal
symmetric_df = asymmetrise(category_df, Species1, Species2)
symmetric_df$percentage.diagonal[symmetric_df$Species1==symmetric_df$Species2] = 1.00


###########################################
################# PLOT ####################
###########################################

TS_AS_conservation_heatmap = ggplot(tibble(symmetric_df), aes(x=Species2, y=Species1)) +
  geom_asymmat(aes(fill_tl=percentage.y, fill_br=percentage.x)) +
  scale_fill_br_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), breaks=number_ticks(5), 
                         name=paste0("Prop of ", unname(category_labels["reg_exon_orth"]), " ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " TS-AS:")) +
  scale_fill_tl_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), guide="none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  #ggtitle(paste0(unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " ~ ", unname(category_labels["reg_exon_orth"]), " TS exons")) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Query species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(name="Target species", labels=species_labels)

print(TS_AS_conservation_heatmap)
```

```{r EDF_TS_GE_Rcons_heatmap, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
##########################################
############### PRELIMINARY ##############
##########################################

node_species = list(
  Bilateria = Bilateria,
  Euarchontoglires = Euarchontoglires,
  Eutheria = Eutheria,
  Mammalia = Mammalia,
  Amniota = Amniota,
  Tetrapoda = Tetrapoda,
  Euteleostomi = Euteleostomi,
  Vertebrata = Vertebrata,
  Chordata = Chordata,
  Deuterostoma = Deuterostoma,
  Cyclorrapha = Cyclorrapha,
  Diptera = Diptera,
  Panorpidae = Panorpidae,
  Oligoneoptera = Oligoneoptera,
  Holometabola = Holometabola,
  Neoptera = Neoptera,
  Insecta = Insecta,
  Arthropoda = Arthropoda,
  Protostoma = Protostoma,
  Outgroups = Outgroups
)

node_lookup = enframe(node_species, name = "Node", value = "Species") %>%
  unnest_longer(Species)

species_lookup = tibble(Node = ordered_species, Species = ordered_species)

lookup = bind_rows(node_lookup, species_lookup) %>%
  distinct(Node, Species)

##########################################
######## INPUT GAINS/LOSSES ##############
##########################################

### I really need to take into account the losses as well. So:
# 1. Upload the best-TS file
# 2. Upload the gains file
# 3. Select the species within the gains
# 4. Remove the species within the losses (if any)

#### Upload gains info
TS_GE_gains_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  input_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", loop_tissue, "_inferred_gains.tab"), 
                        header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("OG_ID", "Node", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue,
           Inference_type = "Gain")
  ### Join to full dataframe
  TS_GE_gains_df = TS_GE_gains_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
}

#### Upload losses info
TS_GE_losses_df = data.frame()
for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  input_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", loop_tissue, "_inferred_losses.tab"), 
                        header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("OG_ID", "Node", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue,
           Inference_type = "Loss")
  ### Join to full dataframe
  TS_GE_losses_df = TS_GE_losses_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
}

### Expand gain/losses dataframes to include all the species within the nodes
TS_GE_gains_expanded_df = TS_GE_gains_df %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "Node") %>%
  relocate(Species, .after = Node)

TS_GE_losses_expanded_df = TS_GE_losses_df %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "Node") %>%
  relocate(Species, .after = Node)


##########################################
######## INPUT TS NUMBERS ################
##########################################

### All TS-GE genes in each species
all_species_GE_regulated_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### Upload input
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_species_GE_regulated_df = all_species_GE_regulated_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(GE_regulated_df)
}

### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))
### Add gene orthogroup
all_species_GE_regulated_df = all_species_GE_regulated_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))

### Numbers of TS-GE genes in each species
all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### Get total number of TS-GE genes in all species
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
  ### For each tissue, compute the total number of genes
  for (loop_tissue in ordered_tissues) {
    tissue_GE_regulated_df = GE_regulated_df %>%
      filter(grepl(loop_tissue, Tissue)) %>%
      dplyr::select(GeneID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(Tissue = loop_tissue) %>%
      group_by(Tissue) %>%
      summarize(Tot_TS_GE_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Species = species)
    ### Join to final df
    all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(tissue_GE_regulated_df)
  }
}

##########################################
############### PROCESS ##################
##########################################

### Upload best-TS
all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df = data.frame()


best_TS_OGs_file = paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", tissue, "_specific_OGs.tab")
best_TS_OGs_df = read.delim(best_TS_OGs_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID", "Tau", "Associated_tissue", "Expr_cutoff"))

### Compute total numbers of TS-GE genes in each species
best_TS_OGs_df = best_TS_OGs_df %>%
  ### Add TS_tissue
  mutate(Tissue = tissue) %>%
  ### Filter only actual TS genes
  filter(Tau >= 0.75, grepl(tissue, Associated_tissue), Expr_cutoff=="YES_EXPR") %>%
  ### Select only species within the gains
  dplyr::left_join(TS_GE_gains_expanded_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Species", "Tissue")) %>%
  ### Remove the species with losses
  dplyr::anti_join(TS_GE_losses_expanded_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Species", "Tissue"))

for (query_species in ordered_species) {
  print(query_species)
  for (target_species in ordered_species[ordered_species != query_species]) {
    query_target_best_TS_OGs_df = best_TS_OGs_df %>%
      group_by(OG_ID, Node, Category) %>%
      filter(any(Species == query_species) & 
            any(Species == target_species)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(Species == query_species) %>%
      dplyr::select(OG_ID, Tissue, Species) %>%
      ### Add all tissue-specific genes of the query species
      dplyr::left_join(all_species_GE_regulated_df, by=c("OG_ID", "Tissue", "Species")) %>%
      mutate(Target_species = target_species) %>%
      group_by(Tissue, Species, Target_species) %>%
      summarize(Tot_conserved_TS_genes = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      ### Add original numbers
      dplyr::left_join(all_species_GE_regulated_stats_df, by=c("Tissue", "Species"))
    
    ### Join to final dataframe
    all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(query_target_best_TS_OGs_df)
  }
}


all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_formatted_df = all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_df %>%
  mutate(Rcons_prop = Tot_conserved_TS_genes / Tot_TS_GE_genes) %>%
  rename("Query_species" = "Species") %>%
  mutate(Query_species = factor(Query_species, levels=ordered_species_tree),
         Target_species = factor(Target_species, levels=ordered_species_tree))

###########################################
################# PLOT ####################
###########################################
  
TS_GE_conservation_heatmap = ggplot(data=all_species_GE_regulated_stats_by_query_formatted_df, aes(x=Query_species, y=Target_species, fill=Rcons_prop)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(limits=my_limits, low = "white", high = unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), oob = scales::squish,
                      name=paste0("Prop of R-cons ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), " TS-GE:")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Query species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(name="Target species", labels=species_labels) +
  coord_fixed()

print(TS_GE_conservation_heatmap)
```

<!-- Panel CD: R-conserved TS-AS and TS-GE across clades -->
```{r EDF_define_R-conserved_TS_AS, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

################################
######## INPUT #################
################################

### Upload exon orthogroups
exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID

exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) #%>%
  ### Filter out exons with low membership scores
  #filter(Membership_score >= 0.15)

###################################
###### UPLOAD TS-AS INFO ##########
###################################

all_species_AS_types_input_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_AS_types_input_df = all_species_AS_types_input_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD TAU INFO #########
###################################

all_taus_conserved_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  tau_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-tau-all_EX_events.tab")
  tau_df = read.delim(tau_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Tau"))
  ### Filter only for the VastIDs present in the exon orthogroups
  filtered_tau_df = tau_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_taus_conserved_df = all_taus_conserved_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_tau_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD RANKED PSI INFO #####
###################################

all_PSI_ranks_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  PSI_ranks_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-ranked_PSIs-all_EX_events.tab")
  PSI_ranks_df = read.delim(PSI_ranks_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Top_tissue", "PSI", "Rank"))
  filtered_PSI_ranks_df = PSI_ranks_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID & Rank == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(VastID, Top_tissue) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_PSI_ranks_df = all_PSI_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_PSI_ranks_df)
}
    

###################################
###### INTEGRATE TS-AS INFO #######
###################################

### Integrate AS information to the exon orthogrourps
AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df = exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_AS_types_input_df, by=join_by("Species"=="Species", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "VastID"=="EventID")) %>%
  left_join(all_taus_conserved_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  left_join(all_PSI_ranks_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  mutate(AS_type = ifelse(AS_type != "TS_AS", "NO_AS", AS_type))


###################################
###### GET CLADE-SPECIFIC EXOGs ###
###################################

clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = data.frame()
### Cycle on all clades
for (clade in all_clades) {
  ### Isolate species of the clade in question
  clade_species = get(clade)
  ### Select earliest diverging species. If most recent nodes, select both daughter species
  last_species = clade_species[length(clade_species)]
  if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {last_species = clade_species}
  
  ### Select exon orthogroups with Neural TS-AS in that clade
  TS_AS_exon_orthogroups = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    ### Require earliest diverging species to be Neural. Require that none of the species outside the clade to be Neural.
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    ### Require that the earliest diverging species are Neural or Neural-like. Require that NONE of the other species is neural or neural-like.
    filter(
      any((Species %in% last_species & Tissue==tissue) | (Species %in% last_species & Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue), na.rm = TRUE) &
      !any(!(Species %in% clade_species) & (Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ### Select Neural and Neural-like TS-AS exons for the species belonging to each clade
    filter(Species %in% clade_species) %>%
    filter(Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)) %>%
    ### Compute total numbers of Neural exons in each orthogroups
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    summarize(Tot_AS_species = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    ### Require at least 50% of the species to have at least one Neural exons. In case of the earliest diverging nodes, require BOTH species.
    filter(Tot_AS_species >= if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {length(clade_species)} else 
      {0.5 * length(clade_species)}) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    .$ExOG_ID
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  ### The selected ExOG_IDs are considered R-conserved in the relative clade.
  clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(ExOG_ID = TS_AS_exon_orthogroups,
                                Clade = rep(clade, length(TS_AS_exon_orthogroups))))
}


#######################################################
################ ADD EXTRA CATEGORIES #################
#######################################################

### Classify the exon orthogroups containing G-conserved Neural TS-exons that we failed to clearly classify
other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  ### Exclude the classified conserved exons
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% as.vector(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID))) %>%
  ### Only select truly Neural TS-AS exons
  filter(AS_type == "TS_AS", Tissue == tissue) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ### Compute the number of species with Neural TS-AS exons
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
  ### All this sequence of conditions work from the bottom up:
  ### If there are Neural species on both branches that do not respect the criteria for ancestrality (see below): Others
  mutate(Category = "Others-Bilateria") %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Deuterostoma), "Unclear-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Protostoma), "Unclear-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Deuterostoma, "Single_species-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Protostoma, "Single_species-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there are at least one vertebrate, one insects, one vertebrate outgroup and one insect outgroup: acnestral biltateria.
  mutate(Category = ifelse(any(Species %in% Vertebrata) & any(Species %in% Insecta) & any(Species %in% c("Bla", "Sp2")) & any(Species %in% c("Sma", "Obi")) & Tot_TS_species >= 9, "Ancestral-Bilateria", Category)) %>%
  separate(Category, c("Category", "Clade_group"), remove=TRUE, sep="-") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Species) %>%
  distinct()

########################################################
################ CLASSIFY UNCLEAR ONES #################
########################################################

#### I think the unclear cases might be cases of TS loss rather than anything else
### The idea is that if the TS-AS exons only differ for -/+ 3nt, they are likely the same ancestral exon even if their phylogenetic distribution does not truly suppoer that
unclear_conservation_cases_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(Category == "Unclear")
  
#### Select those unclear cases where all TS exons have the same length (-/+3).
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>% 
  inner_join(unclear_conservation_cases_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>% 
  filter(Tissue==tissue) %>% 
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Avg_exon_length = mean(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, exon_length, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  mutate(original_exon_length = exon_length) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(exon_length = {x = sort(unique(exon_length))
      is_chain <- all(diff(x) == 3)
      small_group <- length(x) <= 3
      if (is_chain && small_group) {min(x)} else {exon_length}}) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-original_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  summarize(Number_lengths = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Number_lengths == 1) %>%
  .$ExOG_ID

#### These unclear cases are labelled as conserved, setting their emergence to the LCA of all species with Neural TS-AS exons.
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector) %>%
  ### Filter with the TS requirements
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Clade = find_LCA_clade(unique(Species), clade_list), .groups="drop") #%>%

########################################################
################ UPDATE CLASSIFICATIONS ################
########################################################

### Update previous dataframes to include the new classification
clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df)

other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df$ExOG_ID)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Category == "Unclear", "Others", Category))

########################################################
################ SAVE R-CONS OGs TO FILE ###############
########################################################

Rcons_ExOGs_to_save_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% 
                     filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>% 
                     dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Clade_group) %>% 
                     dplyr::rename("Clade"="Clade_group"))
  
write.table(Rcons_ExOGs_to_save_df, 
            file=paste0("/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/data/TS_AS_gains/", tissue, "-Rcons_ExOGs_by_clade.tab"), 
            sep="\t", quote=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

############################################
######## NUMBERS OF CONSERVED EX_OGs #######
############################################

### Count how many ExOGs per ancestor there are
collapsed_clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  group_by(Clade) %>%
  summarize(Conserved_exon_OGs = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(Clade_group = ifelse(Clade %in% all_clades[1:9], "Vertebrata", "Insecta")) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = match(Clade, all_clades)) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = ifelse(Tree_level >= 10, Tree_level-9, Tree_level)) %>%
  ### Add ancestral exons to this plot (currently they are in the other dataframe)
  dplyr::bind_rows(other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% 
                     group_by(Category) %>%
                     summarize(Conserved_exon_OGs = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
                     filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>%
                     dplyr::select(-Category) %>%
                     mutate(Clade_group = "Bilateria",
                            Clade = "Bilateria",
                            Tree_level = 10)) %>%
  mutate(Tree_level = factor(Tree_level, levels=seq(1,10))) %>%
  mutate(Clade = factor(Clade, levels=c(all_clades, "Bilateria"))) %>%
  mutate(Clade_group = factor(Clade_group, levels=c("Vertebrata", "Insecta", "Bilateria"))) %>%
  ### Add conservation category
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Clade %in% c("Bilateria", "Deuterostoma", "Vertebrata", "Protostoma", "Insecta", "Chordata", "Arthropoda"), "Highly_conserved", "Conserved")) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Highly_conserved", "Conserved")))
```

```{r EDF_define_R-conserved_TS_GE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}
#### Upload gains info
TS_GE_gains_df = read.delim(paste0(ts_gains_losses_dir, "All_version2/inferences/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-All_genes-", tissue, "_inferred_gains.tab"),
```

```{r EDF_compare_exon_lengths, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
        legend.position="right") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, 300)) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", ref.group = "Highly_conserved", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = FALSE, step.increase = 0.08,  label.y = 250, size=5) +
  ylab("Exon length") +
  xlab("") +
  guides(fill="none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("Single_species"="One\nTS species", "Highly_conserved"="Highly\nconserved")) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol=1, scales="free_y", labeller = as_labeller(c("Hs2"="Hsa", "Dme"="Dme")))

print(length_comparison_plot)
```
