```{r EDF_conservation_convergence_by_species-v1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
#### IMPORTANT: This relies on the inputs generated for panel C

#### If the exons are in the conserved or highly conserved exon orthogroups: conserved
#### All other exons:
### If the exons are in sub-exon orthogroups or BH with other Neural exons: convergence type I
### If the exon is in a gene orthogroup with other Neural exons: convergence type II
### Otherwise: the exon is new!

#############################
######## INPUT ##############
#############################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

### Select only Conserved exon orthogroups
conserved_exon_orthogroups_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% c(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID, 
                        other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>% 
                          .$ExOG_ID)) %>%
  filter(Tissue == tissue)

### BH
### Build vastID file

#### Upoload files with all vastIDs of TS-AS exons. It contains also vastID of overlapping exons. We would get some missing results otherwise
all_vastIDs_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  vast_ID_file = paste0(ts_info_file_dir, species, "-bilaterian_conserved-ts_info.tab")
  vast_ID_df = read.delim(vast_ID_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    filter(Direction == "UP" &
             grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_vastIDs_df = all_vastIDs_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(vast_ID_df)
}

### Select all neural exons. This dataframe will be needed to derive the convergence type II statistics.
all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

#############
#############

### I am adding the original exon clusters
### Upload not-reclustered exon orthogroups
original_exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_clusters-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID

original_exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(original_exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species, GeneID, Coordinate) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID"="ExOG_ID")

#############
#############

convergence_type_I_df = data.frame()
### Cycle on all species_pairs
for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
  species_query = sub("-.*", "", species_pair)
  
  ### Check if the relative file exists from the compare exons exists (it will be missing for species without samples of the selected tissue)
  ### IMPORTANT: consider here to do a run with the clustered, rather than the reclustered.
  ### Or: add the original exon cluster for both entries. If these are identical, the label should be set to UNCLEAR or something (if not conserved).
  
  species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, tissue, "/OrthoGenes_with_reg_exons-", species_pair, ".tab")
  ### If file exists and it's not empty
  if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
    species_pair_df = read_tsv(species_pair_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      ### Add original ExOG_ID for both coordinates
      left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_1"=="Species", "GeneID_1"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_1"=="Coordinate")) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_1"="Original_ExOG_ID") %>%
      left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_2"=="Species", "GeneID_2"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_2"=="Coordinate")) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_2"="Original_ExOG_ID")
    
    if (nrow(species_pair_df) > 0) {
      species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
        ### select best-hit of any kind. This should indicate Neural TS-AS exons that do not end up in the same exon orthogroup but indeed fall in the same intron position.
        filter(grepl("BEST_HIT", CONSERV_CALL) | Original_ExOG_ID_1 == Original_ExOG_ID_2) %>%
        ### Select relevant fields
        dplyr::select(Ex_cluster_1, GeneID_1, Exon_coord_1, Species_1, Species_2, Ex_cluster_2, CONSERV_CALL) %>%
        dplyr::rename("ExOG_ID"="Ex_cluster_1",
                      "ExOG_ID_target"="Ex_cluster_2",
                      "GeneID"="GeneID_1",
                      "Coordinate"="Exon_coord_1",
                      "Species"="Species_1",
                      "Species_target"="Species_2") %>%
        ### Add vastID
        left_join(all_vastIDs_df, by=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "Species"))
      
      ### Join to dataframe
      convergence_type_I_df = convergence_type_I_df %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(species_pair_df)
    }
  }
}

### This contains all gene orthogroups where there are at least 2 Neural exons.
### If only one neural exons, they should be classified as novel
convergence_type_II_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
  inner_join(all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
               filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)), by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(OG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
  filter(Tot_TS_species > 1)

#######################################################
###### ASSIGN CONSERVATION LABEL ######################
#######################################################

### There is priority in the conservation labels: Conserved, Convergent type I, Convergent type II, New
all_classified_ts_exons_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
  ### Add gene orthogroup ID
  left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = "New") %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(OG_ID %in% convergence_type_II_df$OG_ID, "Convergent_type_II", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% convergence_type_I_df$VastID, "Convergent_type_I", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% conserved_exon_orthogroups_df$VastID, "Conserved", Evo_category)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species),
         Evo_category = factor(Evo_category, levels=rev(c("Conserved", "Convergent_type_I", "Convergent_type_II", "New"))))
  
#############################
######### PLOT ##############
#############################

evo_classified_ts_exons_plot = ggplot(data=all_classified_ts_exons_df, aes(x=Species, fill=Evo_category)) +
  geom_bar(alpha=0.7, stat="count", position=position_fill(), color="white") +

<!-- Panel J: Saturation of convergence type II -->
```{r EDF_saturation_of_OG_with_TS-AS_exons, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
# The tissue variable is still being defined in the first chunck relative to this Figure

########################################
############## INPUT ###################
########################################

#### Upload gene orthogroups
gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

### Upload exon orthogroups
exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID
exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length"))

for (tissue in tissue) {
  print(tissue)
### Upload reference TS-AS exons
reference_TS_AS_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  ### Upload all TS-AS events within bilaterian-conserved genes by species
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    #### Only selected tissue
    filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  reference_TS_AS_df = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

#### Collapse: if TS exons belong to the same ExOG_ID, only select one
temporary_df = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  left_join(exon_orthogroups_df %>% dplyr::select("VastID", "GeneID", "Species", "ExOG_ID"), by=join_by("EventID"=="VastID", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "Species"=="Species"))

processed_reference_TS_AS_df = bind_rows(temporary_df  %>% filter(is.na(ExOG_ID)),
                                         temporary_df  %>% 
                                           filter(!is.na(ExOG_ID)) %>% 
                                           distinct(ExOG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE))

#### Get numbers to filter the randomizations
randomized_numbers_df = processed_reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(Tot_TS_events = n(), .groups = "drop")

### Get number of affected gene orthogroups in the reference set
TS_OGs_number_reference = processed_reference_TS_AS_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  .$OG_ID %>%
  unique() %>%
  length()

#### Upload files with randomized TS-AS
all_rand_rounds_df = data.frame()
for (rand_round in seq(1,10)) {
  print(rand_round)
  rand_round_df = data.frame()
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    tot_events = randomized_numbers_df %>% filter(Species == species) %>% .$Tot_TS_events
    if (length(tot_events) > 0) {
      ### Upload TS-AS per species and randomized
      input_file = paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/randomization_", rand_round, "/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab")
      input_df = read.delim(input_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>% 
        filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
        slice_sample(n = tot_events) %>%
        mutate(Species = species,
               Rand_round = rand_round) 
      ### Add to rand round df
      rand_round_df = rand_round_df %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows(input_df)
    }
  }
  
  #### Add gene orthogroups and count
  rand_round_df = rand_round_df %>%
    left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID"))
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  all_rand_rounds_df = all_rand_rounds_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(rand_round_df)
}

#########################################
############### CUM DISTRIBS RAND #######
#########################################

rand_cumulative_distribs_df = data.frame()

for (rand_round in seq(1,10)) {
  initialized_OG_vector = vector()
  selected_rand_rounds_df = all_rand_rounds_df %>%
    filter(Rand_round == rand_round)
  
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    species_OG_vector = selected_rand_rounds_df %>%
      filter(Species == species) %>%
      dplyr::select(OG_ID)%>%
     .$OG_ID %>%
      unique()
    
    ### Compute total numbers of orthogrorups
    extra_TS_AS_OGs = unique(species_OG_vector[!(species_OG_vector  %in% initialized_OG_vector)])
    
    rand_cumulative_distribs_df = rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Category = paste0("Randomization_", rand_round),
                                  Species = species,
                                  Tot_TS_OGs = length(extra_TS_AS_OGs)))
    
    ### Update vector
    initialized_OG_vector = c(initialized_OG_vector, extra_TS_AS_OGs)
    }
}

complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df = rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>% 
  group_by(Category) %>%
  mutate(cum_Tot = cumsum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac = cum_Tot / sum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac_all = cum_Tot /  length(unique(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species))

#########################################
############### CUM DISTRIBS REF ########
#########################################

ref_cumulative_distribs_df = data.frame()
initialized_OG_vector = vector()

for (species in ordered_species) {
  species_OG_vector = reference_TS_AS_df %>%
    left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df , by=c("GeneID", "Species")) %>%
    filter(Species == species) %>%
    dplyr::select(OG_ID)%>%
   .$OG_ID %>%
    unique()
  
  ### Compute total numbers of orthogrorups
  extra_TS_AS_OGs = unique(species_OG_vector[!(species_OG_vector  %in% initialized_OG_vector)])
  
  ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Category = "Reference",
                                Species = species,
                                Tot_TS_OGs = length(extra_TS_AS_OGs)))
  
  ### Update vector
  initialized_OG_vector = c(initialized_OG_vector, extra_TS_AS_OGs)
}

complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df = ref_cumulative_distribs_df %>% 
  mutate(cum_Tot = cumsum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac = cum_Tot / sum(Tot_TS_OGs),
         cum_frac_all = cum_Tot /  length(unique(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df$OG_ID))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species)) %>%
  mutate(Group = "All")

#########################################
############### COMPUTE SATURATION ######
#########################################

### This is the curve: y=a(1−e−bx)
########################
####### REFERENCE ######
########################

### Input
df = complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df

### Add difference in fraction
df$delta_frac_all = c(NA, diff(df$cum_frac_all))
df$x = seq_len(nrow(df))

### Fit model
fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ a * (1 - exp(-b * x)),
          data = df,
          start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))

# fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ (a * x) / (b + x),
#           data = df,
#           start = list(a = 1, b = 5))


### Predicted maximum achievable fraction
ref_asymtote = round(coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)
#If ≈ 0.95–1.0 → essentially saturate. 0.88: we reached 88% of the predicted value
ref_saturation = round(tail(df$cum_frac_all, 1) / coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)

### The remaining cumulative fraction yet to be discovered is ~12% of the model’s predicted total.
epsilon <- 0.005  # 0.5%
k = 5
ref_saturation_reached = all(tail(df$delta_frac_all, k) < epsilon)

#############################
####### RANDOMIZATIONS ######
#############################

### Input
df = complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(cum_frac_all = mean(cum_frac_all, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

### Add difference in fraction
df$delta_frac_all = c(NA, diff(df$cum_frac_all))
df$x = seq_len(nrow(df))

### Fit model
fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ a * (1 - exp(-b * x)),
          data = df,
          start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))

# fit = nls(cum_frac_all ~ (a * x) / (b + x),
#           data = df,
#           start = list(a = 1, b = 5))


### Predicted maximum achievable fraction
rand_asymtote = round(coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)
#If ≈ 0.95–1.0 → essentially saturate. 0.88: we reached 88% of the predicted value
rand_saturation = round(tail(df$cum_frac_all, 1) / coef(fit)["a"][[1]], 2)

### The remaining cumulative fraction yet to be discovered is ~12% of the model’s predicted total.
epsilon <- 0.005  # 0.5%
k = 5
rand_saturation_reached = all(tail(df$delta_frac_all, k) < epsilon)

#########################################
############### PLOT ####################
#########################################

completed_cumulative_distribs_plot = ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all), color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), size=3) +
  geom_line(data=complete_ref_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all, group=Group), color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue])) +
  geom_jitter(data=complete_rand_cumulative_distribs_df, aes(x=Species, y=cum_frac_all), alpha=0.5, color="dimgray", fill="dimgray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=ref_asymtote, color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=rand_asymtote, color="dimgray", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(x=20, y=1),
            label=paste0("TS asymptote: ", ref_asymtote, "\nTS saturation: ", ref_saturation), 
            color=unname(tissue_colors[tissue]), hjust=1, vjust=1, size=4) +
    geom_text(aes(x=20, y=0.8),
            label=paste0("Rand asymptote: ", rand_asymtote, "\nRand saturation: ", rand_saturation), 
            color="dimgray", hjust=1, vjust=1, size=4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
         axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", face="bold", hjust=0.5)) +
  #ggtitle(tissue) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Species", labels=species_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(paste0("Prop of gene OGs with ", unname(tissue_labels[tissue]), "TS-AS exons"), limits=c(0,1))

print(completed_cumulative_distribs_plot)
}

```{r plot_extree, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warrning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=18, fig.height=13}
#####################################################

expression_file="/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/src/nextflow/all_species_output/normalized_expr_table-ExTree_input.tab"

gene_table = read.table(gene_clusters_file, header=FALSE, na.strings="NA", col.name=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID", "GeneName"))
all_exons_table = read.table(processed_exon_clusters_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="\"", 
                             col.names=c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID", "Coordinate", "Species", "Membership_score", "VastID", "Overlap_groupID", "OG_ID", "Info", "Exon_length", 
                                         "Neural_PSI", "Testis_PSI", "Ovary_PSI", "Muscle_PSI", "Kidney_PSI", "Epithelial_PSI", "DigestiveTract_PSI", "Adipose_PSI", "GeneName"),
                             na.strings=c("NA")) #%>%
  ### require membership scorre higher than 0.15
  #filter(Membership_score >= 0.15)
  

#####################################################

#####################################################

#antonio_ids = c("HsaEX0020591", "DmeEX0009658", "HsaEX0058023")

#####################################################

###### Filter only for the exons of interest

if (length(missing_exons > 0)) {message(paste0("Sorry, ", missing_exons, " are not in the current exon clusters version."))}


#####################################################
########### MERGE EXON AND GENE INFO ################
#####################################################
gene_formatted_df = gene_table %>%
  mutate(GeneName = as.character(GeneName),
         GeneName = if_else(is.na(GeneName) | GeneName == "NA", "no_name", GeneName),
         Complete_ID = paste(OG_ID, GeneID, GeneName, sep = ";"))

exon_formatted_df = exon_table %>%
  mutate(GeneName = as.character(GeneName),
         GeneName = if_else(is.na(GeneName) | GeneName == "NA", "no_name", GeneName),
         VastID   = as.character(VastID),
         VastID   = if_else(is.na(VastID), "NA", VastID),
         OG_ID = str_remove(ExOG_ID, "\\..*"),
         Complete_ID = paste(OG_ID, GeneID, GeneName, sep = ";"))

missing_columns = c(setdiff(colnames(exon_formatted_df), colnames(gene_formatted_df)))
missing_columns = missing_columns[missing_columns != "ExOG_ID"]

### Select genes in gene orthogroup without exon ortholog and add them to the table
missing_genes_df = gene_formatted_df %>%
  filter(!(Complete_ID %in% exon_formatted_df$Complete_ID)) %>%

  ### Add missing columns so that it can be joined to the previous df
  mutate(!!!setNames(replicate(length(missing_columns), "NI", simplify = FALSE), missing_columns)) %>%
  dplyr::select(colnames(exon_formatted_df)) %>%

         Info = "no_info") %>%

### Join table
complete_exon_formatted_df = exon_formatted_df %>%

  dplyr::bind_rows(missing_genes_df) %>%
  distinct()

#####################################################
##################  FORMAT ##########################
#####################################################

all_plots_input_df = complete_exon_formatted_df %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df = .x %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = ordered_species)) %>%
      arrange(Species) %>%
      mutate(ID = paste(Species, GeneName, GeneID, VastID, Exon_length, Coordinate, sep = ";")) %>%
      rename_with(~ str_remove(.x, "_PSI")) %>%
      ### Pivot
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ordered_tissues), names_to = "Tissue", values_to = "PSI") %>%
      mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels = rev(ordered_tissues)),
             ID = factor(ID, levels = rev(unique(ID))))
    
    ## Preserve original PSI
    Original_PSI = df$PSI
    
    df %>%
      mutate(PSI = as.character(PSI), 
             PSI = if_else(PSI == "NI", NA_character_, PSI),
             PSI = as.numeric(PSI),
        
        Scaled_PSI = if_else(!is.na(PSI), PSI / 100, NA_real_),
        
        NA_info = case_when(is.na(Scaled_PSI) ~ "yes_NA",
                            Original_PSI == "NI" ~ "yes_NA",
                            TRUE ~ "no_NA"),
        Scaled_PSI = replace_na(Scaled_PSI, 0),
        Unit = 1,
        
        Exon_info = case_when(
          VastID == "NI" ~ "NI_no_info",
          VastID != "NA" ~ paste0("exon_", Info),
          TRUE ~ paste0("exon_no_", Info)
        ),
        
        Label = str_replace(ID, ";", " ~ ") %>%
          str_remove(";.*")
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


############################################################################
##################  PLOT ###################################################
############################################################################
plot_list = list()
my_index = 1

for (ExOG in unique(all_plots_input_df$ExOG_ID)) {
  my_subset = all_plots_input_df %>%
    filter(ExOG_ID == ExOG) %>%
    distinct()
  my_subset$label = gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(my_subset$ID)))
  
  ### This is to give a title at the end
  my_first_species = as.character(my_subset$Species)[1] #select the "first" species in the cluster. See ordered_species variable
  my_first_species_genes = paste(unique(as.vector(my_subset$GeneName)[my_subset$Species == my_first_species]), collapse = ', ') #get the gene names separated by a comma.
  if (my_first_species == "Hs2") {my_first_species = "Hsa"}
  if (my_first_species == "Mm2") {my_first_species = "Mmu"}
  if (my_first_species == "Bt2") {my_first_species = "Bta"}
  if (my_first_species == "Sp2") {my_first_species = "Spu"}
  
  #########################
  ###### 1. PHYLO TREE ####
  #########################
  my_tree = read.tree(species_tree) #upload phylogenetic tree in newick format
  subset_species = unique(as.character(my_subset$Species)) #select only the species which are present in the current exon cluster
  no_subset_species = ordered_species[!(ordered_species %in% subset_species)] #select only the species that are NOT present in the current exon cluster
  
  #remove from the tree the species which are NOT present in the current exon cluster
  for (species in no_subset_species) {
    my_tree <- drop.tip(my_tree, species)
  }
  
  tree_subset = my_subset %>%
    dplyr::select("GeneID", "VastID", "Coordinate", "Species") %>%
    distinct()
  
  #for each species (in the cluster), add a leaf for each of their exons.
  for (species in subset_species) {
    occurences_number = length(as.character(tree_subset$Species)[as.character(tree_subset$Species) == species]) - 1 #define the number of leaves to add for each species
    if (occurences_number > 0) {
      for (i in seq(occurences_number)) {
        #NB: this will be visualized as a vertical straight line spanning the two leaves.
        my_tree = bind.tip(my_tree, paste0(species,i), where=which(my_tree$tip.label==species)) #actually add a leaf in the same position as the original one for that species
      }
    }
  }
  my_ggtree = ggtree(my_tree) + geom_tiplab(align=TRUE) + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) + scale_y_tree()
  ### Create dataframe with IDs
  lb = my_tree$tip.label
  my_IDs_df = data.frame(label=lb, label2=gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(my_subset$ID))))
  
  temp_tree = ggtree(my_tree) %<+% my_IDs_df + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
    scale_y_tree()
  
  #########################
  ###### 1. GENE NAMES ####
  #########################
  my_colors = species_colors[gsub(";.*", "",  as.vector(my_subset$ID))]
  species_colors_df = as.data.frame(cbind(as.vector(my_subset$ID), rep(1, length(my_subset$ID)), unname(my_colors), gsub(";.*", "",  as.vector(my_subset$ID))))
  colnames(species_colors_df) = c("ID", "Value", "Color", "Species")
  ### Correct the species names for the label (Ugly, but functional)
  species_colors_df$ID = factor(species_colors_df$ID, levels=rev(unique(my_subset$ID)))
  species_colors_df$Color = as.character(species_colors_df$Color)
  
  species_colors_df$label = gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(species_colors_df$ID)))
  
  ### This has been added later on. Get vastID to be printer
  vastIDs = as.character(as.vector(my_subset$VastID))
  vastIDs[vastIDs %in% c("NA", "NI")] = as.character(sub(".*;", "", as.vector(my_subset$ID[my_subset$VastID %in% c("NA", "NI")])))
  vastIDs[vastIDs == "NI"] = "NA"
  
  #This can probably be improved.
  species_genes_names_plot = suppressMessages(ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=species_colors_df, aes(x=ID, y=Value)) +
                                                geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="white") + #fill with white, so that it never shows.
                                                theme_minimal() +
                                                ggtitle("Species ~ Gene ~ VastID") +
                                                theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                                      axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
                                                      axis.text.y=element_text(size=14, color="black", hjust=0),
                                                      plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size=16, face="bold", hjust = 1.5),
                                                      axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
                                                      panel.background = element_blank(), 
                                                      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                                                      panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
                                                coord_flip() + 
                                                guides(fill=FALSE) + 
                                                scale_x_discrete(breaks=as.vector(my_subset$ID), labels=paste0(str_trunc(gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(my_subset$ID))), 15), " ~ ", vastIDs)) +
                                                scale_y_discrete())
  
  species_colors_plot = suppressMessages(ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=species_colors_df, aes(x=ID, y=Value, fill=Species)) +
                                           geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
                                           theme_minimal() + 
                                           theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), 
                                                 axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
                                                 axis.text.y=element_blank(),
                                                 axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                                 panel.background = element_blank(), 
                                                 panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                                                 panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
                                           coord_flip() + 
                                           scale_fill_manual(values=species_colors) + 
                                           guides(fill=FALSE) + 
                                           scale_x_discrete(breaks=as.vector(my_subset$ID), labels=paste0(str_trunc(gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(unique(my_subset$ID)))), 15), " ~ ", vastIDs)) +
                                           scale_y_discrete())
  
  #########################
  ###### 3. EXON STATE ####
  #########################
  exon_state_plot = suppressMessages(ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=my_subset, aes(x=ID, y=Unit, color=Exon_info, fill=Exon_info)) +
                                       geom_point(stroke=1, shape=21, alpha=0.7, size=4) +
                                       scale_fill_manual(values=c(exon_info="black", exon_no_info="darkgray", no_exon_no_info="white", no_C1C2_no_info="white", NI_no_info="white")) + #define filling colors (from exon info)
                                       scale_color_manual(values=c(exon_info="black", exon_no_info="darkgray", no_exon_no_info="black", no_C1C2_no_info="brown1", NI_no_info="brown1")) + #define border colors (from exon info)
                                       ggtitle("Exon state") +
                                       theme_minimal() +
                                       theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                                             axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                             plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0,"cm"),
                                             axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                                             axis.title.y=element_blank(),
                                             plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
                                             panel.background = element_blank(), 
                                             panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                                             panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
                                       labs(y="") +
                                       scale_y_discrete() +
                                       coord_flip() +
                                       guides(color=FALSE, fill=FALSE)) #remove all guides
  
  
  #########################
  ###### 4. SCALED PSI ####
  #########################
  PSI_plot = suppressMessages(ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=my_subset, aes(x=ID, y=Unit, fill=Tissue, alpha=Scaled_PSI, color=if_else(my_subset$NA_info == "no_NA", "black", NA))) +
                                geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
                                scale_color_identity() +
                                #scale_color_manual(values=c("yes_na"="white", "no_NA"="black")) + #fake color values in order to have none. There is probably a smarter way to do this.
                                scale_fill_manual(values=tissue_colors) + #filling as my tissue color
                                scale_alpha_identity() + #directly use as alpha the value provided (the PSI is scaled between 0-1) 
                                ggtitle("Scaled PSI") + 
                                theme_minimal() +
                                theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
                                      axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=40, hjust=1, size=14), #turn tissue labels of 40 degree
                                      plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size=16, face="bold", hjust=0.5),
                                      axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                                      axis.line = element_blank(), 
                                      axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
                                      panel.background = element_blank(), 
                                      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                                      panel.grid.major = element_blank()) + 
                                scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.5, 7.5, 1)), labels=tissue_labels) + #define the position of the tissue labels (on the originally continuos axis)
                                coord_flip() + #flip coordinates. I might change to directly do the plots on the right side
                                guides(fill=FALSE, color=FALSE, alpha=FALSE)) #remove all the legends
  
  
  #########################
  ###### 5. EXON LENGTH ###
  #########################
  ### Table preparation
  #Recompute exon length from Coordinates for those exons without VastID
  exon_length_table = my_subset[,c("ID", "Exon_length", "Coordinate", "VastID")] #isolate only the ID and the exon length
  exon_length_table$exon_length_from_coordinates = exon_length_table$Exon_length
  exon_length_table$exon_length_from_coordinates[exon_length_table$Coordinate != "NI"] = as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", exon_length_table$Coordinate[exon_length_table$Coordinate != "NI"])) -
    as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", sub(".*:", "", exon_length_table$Coordinate[exon_length_table$Coordinate != "NI"]))) +1
  #This is maybe stupid and unnecessary, but for those with a VastID I keep the length from the vast-tools tables
  exon_length_table$Exon_length[is.na(exon_length_table$Exon_length)] = exon_length_table$exon_length_from_coordinates[is.na(exon_length_table$Exon_length)]
  #I am using the exon ID to create an exon state to use for the alpha.
  exon_length_table$exon_state = exon_length_table$VastID
  exon_length_table$exon_state[exon_length_table$VastID=="NA"] = "no_vast_id"
  exon_length_table$exon_state[exon_length_table$exon_state != "no_vast_id"] = "vast_id"
  exon_length_table$exon_state = factor(exon_length_table$exon_state, levels=c("vast_id", "no_vast_id"))
  
  
  exon_length_table$ID = factor(exon_length_table$ID, levels=rev(unique(my_subset$ID))) #transform the ID column in the previous dataframe in a ordered factor (same order as the original one).
  exon_length_table$Exon_length = as.numeric(exon_length_table$Exon_length) #transform the length column in a numeric vector (God knows what it was before).
  exon_length_table$Exon_length[is.na(exon_length_table$Exon_length)] = 0
  exon_length_table$label = gsub(";.*", "", sub(";", " ~ ", as.vector(exon_length_table$ID)))
  exon_length_table = exon_length_table %>% distinct()
  
  ### Plot
  exon_length_plot = suppressMessages(ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=exon_length_table, aes(x=ID, y=Exon_length, alpha=exon_state)) +
                                        geom_bar(fill="coral3", color="coral3", stat="identity") +
                                        scale_alpha_manual(values=c("vast_id"=0.5, "no_vast_id"=0.1)) +
                                        coord_flip(ylim=c(0, max(exon_length_table$Exon_length)*1.25)) + #define axis limit based on the maximum exon length.
                                        theme_minimal() + 
                                        ggtitle("Exon length (bp)") + 
                                        theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                                              axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                              plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size=16, face="bold", hjust=0.5),
                                              axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                              panel.background = element_blank(), 
                                              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                                              panel.grid.major = element_blank()) + 
                                        geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(Exon_length != 0, Exon_length, NA)), alpha = 0.8, position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=0.5, hjust=-0.25, size=5) +
                                        labs(y="") + scale_y_continuous() +
                                        guides(alpha="none"))
  
  ##################################
  ###### 6. TISSUE SPECIFIC EXPR ###
  ##################################
  #table preparation
  specific_expr_table = final_norm_median_expr_table[as.character(my_subset$GeneID),] #select the genes from the normalized expression table
  #specific_expr_table = specific_expr_table[complete.cases(specific_expr_table),] #remove cases with all NAs. Which should not be necessary.
  missing_genes = as.character(my_subset$GeneID[!(my_subset$GeneID %in% rownames(specific_expr_table))]) #consider the case of genes for which we do not have expr info.
  missing_genes = unique(missing_genes)
  #I know 0 != NA. But so far it's probably the best way to handle it.
  missing_genes_df = data.frame(Neural=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Muscle=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Testis=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Ovary=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Epithelial=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Adipose=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                Kidney=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), 
                                DigestiveTract=rep(0, length(missing_genes)), row.names=missing_genes)
  
  specific_expr_table = rbind(specific_expr_table, missing_genes_df) %>%
    distinct()
  specific_expr_table$Gene = rownames(specific_expr_table) #add extra column for gene names
  specific_expr_table_long = melt(specific_expr_table, "Gene") #melt dataframe into long format
  specific_expr_table_long$Unit = rep(1, nrow(specific_expr_table_long)) #add dummy Unit for plotting the table
  colnames(specific_expr_table_long) = c("Gene", "Tissue", "Intensity", "Unit")
  #Replace NA with 0...
  specific_expr_table_long$Intensity[is.na(specific_expr_table_long$Intensity)] = 0
  
  specific_expr_table_long$Gene = factor(specific_expr_table_long$Gene, levels=rev(as.character(unique(specific_expr_table_long$Gene)))) #create factor for the genes.
  specific_expr_table_long$Tissue = factor(specific_expr_table_long$Tissue, levels=rev(ordered_tissues)) #factor for tissues (order as in the previous table)
  
  
  #plot
  expr_plot = 
    ggplot() +
    #ggtreeplot(temp_tree, data=specific_expr_table_long, aes(x=ID, y=Unit)) +
    geom_bar(data=specific_expr_table_long, aes(x=Gene, y=Unit, fill=Tissue, alpha=Intensity), stat="identity") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=tissue_colors) + #assign tissues colors
    scale_alpha_identity(na.value=0) +
    coord_flip() + 
    ggtitle("Scaled Expr") + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title=element_blank(), 
          axis.text.x=element_text(color="black", hjust=1, angle=40, size=14), 
          axis.text.y=element_blank(), axis.line=element_blank(), 
          plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size=16, face="bold", hjust=0.5),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
          panel.background = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.5, 7.5, 1)), labels=tissue_labels) + 
    guides(fill=FALSE) #define labels (tissue names) and label positions
  
  ##################################
  ############ 7. LEGENDS ##########
  ##################################
  
  legend_input_df = specific_expr_table_long %>%
    dplyr::select(Tissue, Unit) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  plot_for_tissue_legend = ggplot() + 
    geom_bar(data=legend_input_df, aes(x=Tissue, y=Unit, fill=Tissue), stat="identity", alpha=0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=tissue_colors, name="Tissues:", labels=tissue_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(color="black", size=13),
          legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=15),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "horizonal",
          legend.background = element_blank()) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend())
  
  ### Original commented out
  NAinfo_legend_df = data.frame(exon_info=c("No exon", "No VastID", "VastID")) #Create a fake df just to extract the legend
  NAinfo_legend_df$exon_info = factor(NAinfo_legend_df$exon_info, levels=c("VastID", "No VastID", "No exon")) #transform into factor in  order to have an ordered legend.
  plot_for_NAinfo_legend = ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=NAinfo_legend_df, aes(x=exon_info, y=exon_info, color=exon_info, fill=exon_info), stroke=1, size=4, shape=21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("No exon (C1-C2)"="white", "No VastID"="darkgray", "VastID"="black", "No exon"="white"), name="Exon state") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("No exon (C1-C2)"="black", "No VastID"="darkgray", "VastID"="black", "No exon"="brown1"), name="Exon state") +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(color="black", size=13),
          legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=15),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          #legend.spacing = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_blank())
  
  ### Combine legends plots
  my_tissue_legend <- get_legend_safe(plot_for_tissue_legend, position = "bottom")
  my_NAinfo_legend <- get_legend_safe(plot_for_NAinfo_legend, position = "bottom")
  my_legends_plots = plot_grid(my_NAinfo_legend, my_tissue_legend, ncol=1, align="v", rel_heights = c(0.5,2))
  
  ##################################
  ######### COMBINE PLOTS ##########
  ##################################
  all_plots <- plot_grid(temp_tree, species_colors_plot, species_genes_names_plot, exon_state_plot, PSI_plot, exon_length_plot, expr_plot, rel_widths=c(1.1,0.4,2.5,0.3,3.2,1.1,1.6), align="h", ncol=8)
  ### Add title
  my_title = ggdraw() + draw_label(paste0(sub("_", " ", ExOG), " ~ ", my_first_species, " ", my_first_species_genes), fontface="bold", size=20)
  all_plots_title = plot_grid(my_title, all_plots, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(0.1,1))
  ### Add legend
  all_plots_title_legends = plot_grid(all_plots_title, my_legends_plots, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(1,0.1))
  
  print(all_plots_title_legends)
  
  plot_list[[my_index]] = all_plots_title_legends
  my_index = my_index+1
}

for (element in plot_list) {
  print(element)

<!-- Panel A: comparisons of conservation and convergence proportions across tissues -->
```{r conservation_convergence_boxplot_by_tissue, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "function"), fig.height=15, fig.width=13}

### Initialize dataframe
all_tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df = data.frame()

for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
  ### Keep track
  print(tissue)
  ################################
  ######## INPUT #################
  ################################
  
  ### Upload exon orthogroups
  exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
  #Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID
  
  exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) #%>%
    ### Filter out exons with low membership scores
    #filter(Membership_score >= 0.15)
  
  ###################################
  ###### UPLOAD TS-AS INFO ##########
  ###################################
  
  all_species_AS_types_input_df = data.frame()
  for (species in all_species) {
    AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
      mutate(Species = species) %>%
      mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
      dplyr::select(-Direction)
    
    ##### Join to final dataframe
    all_species_AS_types_input_df = all_species_AS_types_input_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
  }
  
  ###################################
  ###### UPLOAD TAU INFO #########
  ###################################
  
  all_taus_conserved_df = data.frame()
  for (species in all_species) {
    tau_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-tau-all_EX_events.tab")
    tau_df = read.delim(tau_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Tau"))
    ### Filter only for the VastIDs present in the exon orthogroups
    filtered_tau_df = tau_df %>%
      filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID) %>%
      mutate(Species = species)
    ### Join to final df
    all_taus_conserved_df = all_taus_conserved_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_tau_df)
  }
  
  ###################################
  ###### UPLOAD RANKED PSI INFO #####
  ###################################
  
  all_PSI_ranks_df = data.frame()
  for (species in all_species) {
    PSI_ranks_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-ranked_PSIs-all_EX_events.tab")
    PSI_ranks_df = read.delim(PSI_ranks_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Top_tissue", "PSI", "Rank"))
    filtered_PSI_ranks_df = PSI_ranks_df %>%
      filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID & Rank == 1) %>%
      dplyr::select(VastID, Top_tissue) %>%
      mutate(Species = species)
    ### Join to final df
    all_PSI_ranks_df = all_PSI_ranks_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_PSI_ranks_df)
  }
      
  
  ###################################
  ###### INTEGRATE TS-AS INFO #######
  ###################################
  
  ### Integrate AS information to the exon orthogrourps
  AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df = exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    left_join(all_species_AS_types_input_df, by=join_by("Species"=="Species", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "VastID"=="EventID")) %>%
    left_join(all_taus_conserved_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
    left_join(all_PSI_ranks_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = ifelse(AS_type != "TS_AS", "NO_AS", AS_type))
  
  
  ###################################
  ###### GET CLADE-SPECIFIC EXOGs ###
  ###################################
  
  clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = data.frame()
  ### Cycle on all clades
  for (clade in all_clades) {
    ### Isolate species of the clade in question
    clade_species = get(clade)
    ### Select earliest diverging species. If most recent nodes, select both daughter species
    last_species = clade_species[length(clade_species)]
    if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {last_species = clade_species}
    
    ### Select exon orthogroups with Neural TS-AS in that clade
    TS_AS_exon_orthogroups = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
      ### Require earliest diverging species to be Neural. Require that none of the species outside the clade to be Neural.
      group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
      ### Require that the earliest diverging species are Neural or Neural-like. Require that NONE of the other species is neural or neural-like.
      filter(
        any((Species %in% last_species & Tissue==tissue) | (Species %in% last_species & Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue), na.rm = TRUE) &
        !any(!(Species %in% clade_species) & (Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      ### Select Neural and Neural-like TS-AS exons for the species belonging to each clade
      filter(Species %in% clade_species) %>%
      filter(Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)) %>%
      ### Compute total numbers of Neural exons in each orthogroups
      dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
      summarize(Tot_AS_species = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      ### Require at least 50% of the species to have at least one Neural exons. In case of the earliest diverging nodes, require BOTH species.
      filter(Tot_AS_species >= if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {length(clade_species)} else 
        {0.5 * length(clade_species)}) %>%
      dplyr::select(ExOG_ID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      .$ExOG_ID
    
    ### Join to final dataframe
    ### The selected ExOG_IDs are considered R-conserved in the relative clade.
    clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(ExOG_ID = TS_AS_exon_orthogroups,
                                  Clade = rep(clade, length(TS_AS_exon_orthogroups))))
  }
  
  
  #######################################################
  ################ ADD EXTRA CATEGORIES #################
  #######################################################
  
  ### Classify the exon orthogroups containing G-conserved Neural TS-exons that we failed to clearly classify
  other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    ### Exclude the classified conserved exons
    filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% as.vector(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID))) %>%
    ### Only select truly Neural TS-AS exons
    filter(AS_type == "TS_AS", Tissue == tissue) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    ### Compute the number of species with Neural TS-AS exons
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    mutate(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
    ### All this sequence of conditions work from the bottom up:
    ### If there are Neural species on both branches that do not respect the criteria for ancestrality (see below): Others
    mutate(Category = "Others-Bilateria") %>%
    ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear vertebrata
    mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Deuterostoma), "Unclear-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
    ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear insecta
    mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Protostoma), "Unclear-Insecta", Category)) %>%
    ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species vertebrata
    mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Deuterostoma, "Single_species-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
    ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species insecta
    mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Protostoma, "Single_species-Insecta", Category)) %>%
    ### If there are at least one vertebrate, one insects, one vertebrate outgroup and one insect outgroup: acnestral biltateria.
    mutate(Category = ifelse(any(Species %in% Vertebrata) & any(Species %in% Insecta) & any(Species %in% c("Bla", "Sp2")) & any(Species %in% c("Sma", "Obi")) & Tot_TS_species >= 9, "Ancestral-Bilateria", Category)) %>%
    separate(Category, c("Category", "Clade_group"), remove=TRUE, sep="-") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Species) %>%
    distinct()
  
  ########################################################
  ################ CLASSIFY UNCLEAR ONES #################
  ########################################################
  
  #### I think the unclear cases might be cases of TS loss rather than anything else
  ### The idea is that if the TS-AS exons only differ for -/+ 3nt, they are likely the same ancestral exon even if their phylogenetic distribution does not truly suppoer that
  unclear_conservation_cases_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
    filter(Category == "Unclear")
    
  #### Select those unclear cases where all TS exons have the same length (-/+3).
  unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>% 
    inner_join(unclear_conservation_cases_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>% 
    filter(Tissue==tissue) %>% 
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    mutate(Avg_exon_length = mean(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, exon_length, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
    ###
    mutate(original_exon_length = exon_length) %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    mutate(exon_length = {x = sort(unique(exon_length))
        is_chain <- all(diff(x) == 3)
        small_group <- length(x) <= 3
        if (is_chain && small_group) {min(x)} else {exon_length}}) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-original_exon_length) %>%
    ###
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
    summarize(Number_lengths = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(Number_lengths == 1) %>%
    .$ExOG_ID
  
  #### These unclear cases are labelled as conserved, setting their emergence to the LCA of all species with Neural TS-AS exons.
  unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    filter(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector) %>%
    ### Filter with the TS requirements
    filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    summarize(Clade = find_LCA_clade(unique(Species), clade_list), .groups="drop") #%>%
  
  ########################################################
  ################ UPDATE CLASSIFICATIONS ################
  ########################################################
  
  ### Update previous dataframes to include the new classification
  clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df)
  
  other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
    filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df$ExOG_ID)) %>%
    mutate(Category = ifelse(Category == "Unclear", "Others", Category))
  
  ################################################################################################################
  ################ SECOND PART ###################################################################################
  ################################################################################################################
  
  #### If the exons are in the conserved or highly conserved exon orthogroups: conserved
  #### All other exons:
  ### If the exons are in sub-exon orthogroups or BH with other Neural exons: convergence type I
  ### If the exon is in a gene orthogroup with other Neural exons: convergence type II
  ### Otherwise: the exon is new!
  
  #############################
  ######## INPUT ##############
  #############################
  
  #### Upload gene orthogroups
  gene_orthogroups_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"
  all_species_gene_orthogroups_df = read.delim(gene_orthogroups_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
    mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))
  
  ### Conserved
  conserved_exon_orthogroups_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    filter(ExOG_ID %in% c(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID, other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>% filter(Category == "Ancestral") %>% .$ExOG_ID)) %>%
    filter(Tissue == tissue)
  
  ### BH
  ### Build vastID file
  
  #### Upoload files with all vastIDs of TS-AS exons. It contains also vastID of overlapping exons. We would get some missing results otherwise
  all_vastIDs_df = data.frame()
  for (species in ordered_species) {
    vast_ID_file = paste0(ts_info_file_dir, species, "-bilaterian_conserved-ts_info.tab")
    vast_ID_df = read.delim(vast_ID_file, header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
      filter(Direction == "UP" &
               grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
      dplyr::select(c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "VastID")) %>%
      mutate(Species = species)
    ### Join to final df
    all_vastIDs_df = all_vastIDs_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(vast_ID_df)
  }
    
  all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = data.frame()
  for (species in all_species) {
    AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
      filter(grepl(tissue, Tissue)) %>%
      mutate(Species = species) %>%
      mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
      dplyr::select(-Direction)
    
    ##### Join to final dataframe
    all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
  }
  
  #############
  #############
  
  ### I am adding the original exon clusters
  ### Upload not-reclustered exon orthogroups
  original_exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_clusters-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
  #Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID
  
  original_exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(original_exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species, GeneID, Coordinate) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID"="ExOG_ID")
  
  #############
  #############
  
  convergence_type_I_df = data.frame()
  ### Cycle on all species_pairs
  for(species_pair in c(first_direction_species_pairs, second_direction_species_pairs)) {
    species_query = sub("-.*", "", species_pair)
    
    ### Check if the relative file exists from the compare exons exists (it will be missing for species without samples of the selected tissue)
    ### IMPORTANT: consider here to do a run with the clustered, rather than the reclustered.
    ### Or: add the original exon cluster for both entries. If these are identical, the label should be set to UNCLEAR or something (if not conserved)
    species_pair_file = paste0(compare_exons_dir, tissue, "/OrthoGenes_with_reg_exons-", species_pair, ".tab")
    ### If file exists and it's not empty
    if (file.exists(species_pair_file)) {
      species_pair_df = read_tsv(species_pair_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        #read.delim(species_pair_file, header=TRUE) %>%
        ### Add original ExOG_ID for both coordinates
        left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_1"=="Species", "GeneID_1"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_1"=="Coordinate")) %>%
        dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_1"="Original_ExOG_ID") %>%
        left_join(original_exon_orthogroups_df, by=join_by("Species_2"=="Species", "GeneID_2"=="GeneID", "Exon_coord_2"=="Coordinate")) %>%
        dplyr::rename("Original_ExOG_ID_2"="Original_ExOG_ID")
      
      if (nrow(species_pair_df) > 0) {
        species_pair_df = species_pair_df %>%
          ### select best-hit of any kind. This should indicate Neural TS-AS exons that do not end up in the same econ orthogroup but indeed fall in the same intron position.
          filter(grepl("BEST_HIT", CONSERV_CALL) | Original_ExOG_ID_1 == Original_ExOG_ID_2) %>%
          ### Select relevant fields
          dplyr::select(Ex_cluster_1, GeneID_1, Exon_coord_1, Species_1, Species_2, Ex_cluster_2, CONSERV_CALL) %>%
          dplyr::rename("ExOG_ID"="Ex_cluster_1",
                        "ExOG_ID_target"="Ex_cluster_2",
                        "GeneID"="GeneID_1",
                        "Coordinate"="Exon_coord_1",
                        "Species"="Species_1",
                        "Species_target"="Species_2") %>%
          ### Add vastID
          left_join(all_vastIDs_df, by=c("GeneID", "Coordinate", "Species"))
        
        ### Join to dataframe
        convergence_type_I_df = convergence_type_I_df %>%
          dplyr::bind_rows(species_pair_df)
      }
    }
  }
  
  ### This contains all gene orthogroups where there are at least 2 Neural exons.
  ### If only one neural exons, they should be classified as novel
  convergence_type_II_df = all_species_gene_orthogroups_df %>%
    inner_join(all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
                 filter(Tissue == tissue), by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
    dplyr::select(OG_ID, Species) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(OG_ID) %>%
    summarize(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
    filter(Tot_TS_species > 1)
  
  #######################################################
  ###### ASSIGN CONSERVATION LABEL ######################
  #######################################################
  
  all_classified_ts_exons_df = all_species_tissue_TS_AS_input_df %>%
    ### Add gene orthogroup ID
    left_join(all_species_gene_orthogroups_df, by=c("Species", "GeneID")) %>%
    mutate(Evo_category = "New") %>%
    mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(OG_ID %in% convergence_type_II_df$OG_ID, "Convergent_type_II", Evo_category)) %>%
    mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% convergence_type_I_df$VastID, "Convergent_type_I", Evo_category)) %>%
    mutate(Evo_category = ifelse(EventID %in% conserved_exon_orthogroups_df$VastID, "Conserved", Evo_category)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species),
           Evo_category = factor(Evo_category, levels=rev(c("Conserved", "Convergent_type_I", "Convergent_type_II", "New"))))
  
  ### Summarize by tissue and join
  tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df = all_classified_ts_exons_df %>%
    group_by(Species, Evo_category, Tissue) %>%
    summarize(Tot_exons_evo_category = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    mutate(Tot_exons = sum(Tot_exons_evo_category)) %>%
    mutate(Proportion_exons_evo_category = Tot_exons_evo_category/Tot_exons)
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  all_tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df = all_tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df)
}

all_tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_formatted_df = all_tissue_summary_all_classified_ts_exons_df %>%
  mutate(Clade = ifelse(Species %in% Vertebrata, "Vertebrata", "Outgroups")) %>%
  mutate(Clade = ifelse(Species %in% Insecta, "Insecta", Clade)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species),
         Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),

```{r complete_fly_experiments, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "function")}

##################################
########### PANEL A ##############

genotype_sex_colors = c("CantonS_F"="black", "CantonS_M"="gray50", "spg_d_F"="brown4", "spg_d_M"="firebrick2", "syd_d_F"="seagreen4", "syd_d_M"="aquamarine3")

### Gravitaxis
climbing_file = paste0(formatted_fly_data_dir, "Climbing_assay.txt")
climbing_df = read.delim(climbing_file, header=TRUE)

formatted_climbing_df = climbing_df %>%
  mutate(across(X0:X15, ~ .x / Total)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = X0:X15,
    names_to = "Time",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Time = as.numeric(str_remove(Time, "^X")))

summary_climbing_df <- formatted_climbing_df %>%
  group_by(Line, Sex, Time) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
            sem = sd(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Line_sex = paste0(Line, "_", Sex))

climbing_plot = ggplot(data = summary_climbing_df, aes(x = Time, y = avg, colour = Line, linetype = Sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg - sem,
                    ymax = avg + sem),
                width = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("CantonS"="gray50", "spg_d"="brown3", "syd_d"="seagreen4"), name="Genotype:", labels=c("CantonS" = "CantonS", "spg_d" = "spg mic-KO", "syd_d" = "syd mic-KO")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid","longdash"), name="Sex:") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"))+
  ylab("% flies reaching 10 cm") +
  xlab("Time (s)")

print(climbing_plot)

##################################
########### PANEL B ##############
##################################

### Survival
input_file = paste0(formatted_fly_data_dir, "/Survival_assay.txt")
input_df = read.delim(input_file, header=TRUE, comment.char = "#")

processed_input_df = input_df %>%
  mutate(strain = factor(Mutant, levels = c(1, 2, 0), labels = c("spg mic-KO", "syd mic-KO", "CantonS")))

### Fit Kaplan-Meier curves
survival_fit = survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ strain, data = processed_input_df)
summary_survival_fit = summary(survival_fit)

kaplan_mayer_df <- tibble(
  time   = summary_survival_fit$time,
  surv   = summary_survival_fit$surv * 100,
  strain = sub("strain=", "", summary_survival_fit$strata)) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(time = 0, 
                   surv = 100, 
                   strain = levels(processed_input_df$strain)))

### Log-rank test
long_rank_test <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ strain, data = processed_input_df)
pvalue  <- pchisq(long_rank_test$chisq, df = length(long_rank_test$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
pvalue_txt <- if (pvalue < 0.0001) "p < 0.0001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pvalue, 2))

kaplan_mayer_plot = ggplot(kaplan_mayer_df, aes(time, surv, color = strain)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  #ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1, y = 15, label = pvalue_txt, hjust = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("spg mic-KO" = "brown3", "syd mic-KO"="seagreen4", "CantonS" = "gray50"), breaks = c("spg mic-KO", "syd mic-KO", "CantonS")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50), ylim = c(-5, 105)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Survival (%)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text()
  )

print(kaplan_mayer_plot)

##################################
########### PANEL C ##############
##################################

### Activity

activity_df = read.delim(activity_file)

  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=30, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        strip.text = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gray50", "brown3", "seagreen4"), name="Genotype:", labels=c("CantonS" = "CantonS", "spg" = "spg mic-KO", "syd" = "syd mic-KO")) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("gray50", "brown3", "seagreen4"), name="Genotype:", labels=c("CantonS" = "CantonS", "spg" = "spg mic-KO", "syd" = "syd mic-KO")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name="Activity counts (10^3/day)", labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1/1000)) +

<!-- Panel A: distributions of gene-level features for randomized sets -->
```{r TS-AS_TS_GE-randomized_features_comparisons, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=4, fig.height=20}
##########################################
########### INPUT FOR PARALOGS ###########
##########################################

### Number of paralogs for all bilaterian conserved genes
bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df = read.delim(paste0(home, "projects/bilaterian_GE/data/gene_sets/All_version2/STRICT/Bilateria/conserved/Bilateria_conserved_orthogroups-EXPR_genes.txt"),
                                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("OG_ID", "Species", "GeneID")) %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "BmA", "Bmo", Species))

geneID_paralog_number_df = bilaterian_conserved_orthogroups_df %>%
  group_by(OG_ID, Species) %>%
  ### I define number of paralogs as the total number of genes from the same species in the same orthogroup
  mutate(Paralog_num = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Paralog_num)


##########################################
########### JOINT INPUTS #################
##########################################

all_randomized_species_features_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  print(species) #To keep track of progress
  for (rand_category in c("reference", paste0("randomization_", seq(1,10)))) {
    for (reg_type in c("GE", "AS")) {
      ### Genomic features
      features_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-gene_length_and_exon_num.tab"), 
                                 header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Gene_length", "Exon_num"))
      ### Sequence similarity
      seq_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_sequence_similarities.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Seq_sim"))
      ### Expression similarity
      expr_sim_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_expression_similarities.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Expr_sim"))
      ### Intergenic distances
      int_dist_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-intergenic_distances.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Int_dist"))
      ### Domain number
      domain_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-total_dom_num.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dom_num"))
      ### Disordered rates
      dis_rate_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/", rand_category, "/", species, "-", reg_type, "_regulated_genes-average_dis_rate.tab"), 
                                         header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue", "Dis_rate"))
      ### Combine dataframes
      reg_type_df = features_df %>%
        mutate(Species = species,
               Reg_type = reg_type,
               Rand_category = rand_category) %>%
        left_join(geneID_paralog_number_df, by="GeneID") %>%
        left_join(seq_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(expr_sim_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(int_dist_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(domain_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
        left_join(dis_rate_df, by=c("GeneID", "Tissue"))
      
      all_randomized_species_features_df = dplyr::bind_rows(all_randomized_species_features_df, reg_type_df)
    }
  }
}

##########################################
######### COMBINE INPUTS #################
##########################################

### Format input
all_randomized_species_features_formatted_df = all_randomized_species_features_df %>%
  mutate(Dom_num = Dom_num / Gene_length) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Paralog_num", "Seq_sim", "Expr_sim", "Int_dist", "Dom_num", "Dis_rate"), names_to="Feature", values_to="Values") %>%
  group_by(Species, Rand_category, Reg_type, Tissue, Feature) %>%
  summarize(Mean_value = mean(Values, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("Species", "Rand_category", "Tissue", "Feature"), names_from=Reg_type, values_from=Mean_value) %>%
  mutate(AS_GE_ratio = log2(AS/GE)) %>%
  ### Compute median by Rand_category
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels=c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Expr_sim", "Dis_rate", "Seq_sim", "Int_dist", "Paralog_num", "Dom_num"))) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = ifelse(Feature %in% c("Gene_length", "Exon_num", "Dis_rate", "Expr_sim"), "AS_higher", "No_diff")) %>%
  mutate(Rand_category = factor(Rand_category, levels=c("reference", paste0("randomization_", seq(1,10))))) %>%
  mutate(Rand_group = ifelse(Rand_category == "reference", "reference", "randomization")) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = ifelse(Feature %in% c("Paralog_num", "Dom_num", "Int_dist"), "GE_higher", Feature_group)) %>%
  mutate(Feature_group = factor(Feature_group, levels=c("AS_higher", "No_diff", "GE_higher")))


###########################################
########## COMPUTE PVALUE #################
###########################################

ref_stats = all_randomized_species_features_formatted_df %>%
  filter(Rand_group == "reference") %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarize(ref_stat = median(AS_GE_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rand_stats = all_randomized_species_features_formatted_df %>%
  filter(Rand_group == "randomization") %>%
  group_by(Feature, Rand_category) %>%
  summarize(rand_stat = median(AS_GE_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

### Permutation test correction
pvalue_df = rand_stats %>%
  left_join(ref_stats, by = "Feature") %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarize(p_value = (sum(abs(rand_stat) >= abs(ref_stat)) + 1) / (n() + 1), .groups = "drop")


###########################################
############# PLOT ########################
###########################################

# 
# print(randomization_comparison_plot)

randomization_comparison_plot = ggplot(data=all_randomized_species_features_formatted_df, aes(x=Rand_category, y=AS_GE_ratio, fill=Rand_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.8, color="black", outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color="black", linetype="dashed") +
