```{r all_GO_plots-CC_MF_BP, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=14, fig.height=18}
########################################
############ INPUTS ####################
########################################

####### Add domain category to GO
GO_annot_domain_file = "/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/data/DB/GO_annot/GO_terms-names-domains_correspondences.tab"
GO_annot_domain_df = read.delim(GO_annot_domain_file, sep="\t", header=FALSE, col.names=c("GO_term", "GO_Name", "GO_domain")) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(GO_term) %>% 
  ### This is because the clueGO ones are annotated in two domains and I do not know how to differentiate them
  mutate(Tot = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ### I have check and only BP and MF overlap. AS BP are so many already, I am "giving" them to the MF
  mutate(GO_domain = ifelse(Tot > 1, "molecular_function", GO_domain)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Tot)
  
### Only select categories that in human have at least 20 genes annotated
size_filtered_categories = GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
  filter(Species == "Hs2", K >= 20) %>%
  .$GO_Name %>%
  unique()

all_GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df = GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
  filter(GO_Name %in% size_filtered_categories) %>%
  mutate(Signif = ifelse(pval <= 0.001, "SIGNIF", "NO_SIGNIF")) %>%
  group_by(GO_Name, Tissue, Reg_type, Signif) %>%
  summarize(Tot_significant = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(Signif == "SIGNIF")

selected_categories = all_GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
  filter(Tot_significant >= 5) %>%
  .$GO_Name %>%
  unique()

### Select categories significant in 12 species or more
### The idea is to capture common enrichments across species within each tissue/reg_layer
shared_GO_categories_df = all_GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
  filter(GO_Name %in% selected_categories) %>%
  ## Add zeros for missing categories
  complete(GO_Name,
           Tissue = ordered_tissues,
           Reg_type = "GE",
           fill = list(Tot_significant = 0)) %>%
  left_join(GO_annot_domain_df, by="GO_Name")


#### Set number of columns
column_numbers = c("cellular_component"=3, "molecular_function"=3, "biological_process"= 3)
# fig_widthts = c("cellular_component"=12, "molecular_function"=8, "biological_process"=15)
# fig_heights = c("cellular_component"=18, "molecular_function"=12, "biological_process"=21)

for (domain in c("cellular_component", "molecular_function", "biological_process")) {
  
  ########################################
  ############ DOMAIN INPUT ##############
  ########################################
  
  ### Isolate categories belonging to domain
  selected_shared_categories_df = shared_GO_categories_df %>%
    filter(GO_domain == domain) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels=ordered_tissues),
    Reg_type = factor(Reg_type, levels=c("AS", "GE")))
  
  if (domain == "biological_process") {
    selected_categories = all_GO_all_species_hypergeo_res_df %>%
      filter(Tot_significant >= 12) %>%
      .$GO_Name %>%
      unique()
    
  selected_shared_categories_df = selected_shared_categories_df %>%
    filter(GO_Name %in% selected_categories)
  }
  
  ### Label GE_only, AS_only, Both
  labels_df = selected_shared_categories_df %>%
    filter(Signif=="SIGNIF") %>%
    dplyr::select(GO_Name, Reg_type) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(GO_Name) %>%
    mutate(Tot = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Reg_type = ifelse(Tot > 1, "Both", as.character(Reg_type))) %>%
    dplyr::rename("Group"="Reg_type") %>%
    distinct()
  
  labelled_selected_shared_categories_df = selected_shared_categories_df %>%
    left_join(labels_df, by="GO_Name") #%>%
    #mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels=c("AS", "GE", "Both")))
  
  ### Cluster and plot
  mat = labelled_selected_shared_categories_df %>%
    mutate(Tissue = as.character(Tissue)) %>%
    dplyr::select(GO_Name, Tissue, Reg_type, Tot_significant) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = c(Reg_type, Tissue),
      values_from = Tot_significant,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("GO_Name") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  mat_scaled = scale(mat)
  hc = hclust(dist(mat_scaled), method = "ward.D2")
  go_order = rownames(mat)[hc$order]
  
  final_go_order = c(go_order[go_order %in% as.vector(subset(labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, Group=="AS")$GO_Name)],
                     go_order[go_order %in% as.vector(subset(labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, Group=="GE")$GO_Name)],
                     go_order[go_order %in% as.vector(subset(labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, Group=="Both"))$GO_Name])

  ordered_labelled_selected_shared_categories_df = labelled_selected_shared_categories_df %>%
    mutate(GO_Name = factor(GO_Name, levels=rev(final_go_order))) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels=c("AS", "GE", "Both"))) %>%
    arrange(Group, GO_Name) %>%
    mutate(Col_group = rep_fill(seq(1,unname(column_numbers[domain])), each = nrow(.)/unname(column_numbers[domain]), len = nrow(.)))
    
  ########################################
  ############ PLOTS #####################
  ########################################
  
  selected_shared_categories_plot = ggplot(ordered_labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, aes(y = GO_Name, x = Tissue)) +
    #### Empty squares for 0
    geom_point(data = subset(ordered_labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, Tot_significant == 0), shape = 22, size = 0, fill = "white", color = "white") +
    #### Filled squares for >0
    geom_point(data = subset(ordered_labelled_selected_shared_categories_df, Tot_significant > 0), aes(size = Tot_significant, fill = Reg_type), shape = 22, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("AS" = "dodgerblue3", "GE" = "brown3"), name = "TS type:", labels=c("AS"="TS-AS", "GE"="TS-GE")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), limits=c(1,20), name = "Tot signif\nspecies", breaks = c(1,5,10,15,20)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
          strip.text = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
    ggtitle(domain %>% str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_to_title()) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) {x %>% str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_to_title() %>% str_trunc(width = 40)}) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=tissue_labels) +
    facet_wrap(~Col_group, ncol=unname(column_numbers[domain]), scales="free_y")
  
  print(selected_shared_categories_plot)
  
  pdf(paste0("/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/tmp_images/paper_images/SupFig-", domain, "-GO_hypergeo_res-v2.pdf"), width=14, height=18)
  print(selected_shared_categories_plot)
  dev.off()
}

```

```{r all_species_exon_lengths_distributions_across_neural_TS_AS_conservation_classes, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions"), fig.width=13.5, fig.height=16}

tissue = "Neural"

################################
######## INPUT #################
################################

### Upload exon orthogroups
exon_orthogroups_file = "/no_backup/mirimia/fmantica/bilaterian_AS/process_exon_orthologies_output-all_vastIDs/EX_reclustered-added_info-bilaterian_conserved-ExTree_input-TS-AS_filtered.tab"
#Header: ExCluster_ID	GeneID	Coordinate	Species	Membership_score	VastID	Overlap_groupID	OG_ID

exon_orthogroups_df = read.delim(exon_orthogroups_file, header=TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("ExOG_ID", "GeneID",	"Coordinate",	"Species",	"Membership_score",	"VastID",	"Overlap_groupID",	"OG_ID", "exon_length")) #%>%
  ### Filter out exons with low membership scores
  #filter(Membership_score >= 0.15)

###################################
###### UPLOAD TS-AS INFO ##########
###################################

all_species_AS_types_input_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  AS_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-AS_regulated_genes-with_event.tab"), 
                               header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "EventID", "Tissue", "Direction")) %>%
    mutate(Species = species) %>%
    mutate(AS_type = "TS_AS") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Direction)
  
  ##### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_AS_types_input_df = all_species_AS_types_input_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(AS_regulated_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD TAU INFO #########
###################################

all_taus_conserved_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  tau_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-tau-all_EX_events.tab")
  tau_df = read.delim(tau_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Tau"))
  ### Filter only for the VastIDs present in the exon orthogroups
  filtered_tau_df = tau_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_taus_conserved_df = all_taus_conserved_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_tau_df)
}

###################################
###### UPLOAD RANKED PSI INFO #####
###################################

all_PSI_ranks_df = data.frame()
for (species in all_species) {
  PSI_ranks_file = paste0(tau_call_dir, species, "-ranked_PSIs-all_EX_events.tab")
  PSI_ranks_df = read.delim(PSI_ranks_file, header=TRUE, col.names=c("VastID", "Top_tissue", "PSI", "Rank"))
  filtered_PSI_ranks_df = PSI_ranks_df %>%
    filter(VastID %in% exon_orthogroups_df$VastID & Rank == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(VastID, Top_tissue) %>%
    mutate(Species = species)
  ### Join to final df
  all_PSI_ranks_df = all_PSI_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_PSI_ranks_df)
}
    

###################################
###### INTEGRATE TS-AS INFO #######
###################################

### Integrate AS information to the exon orthogrourps
AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df = exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  left_join(all_species_AS_types_input_df, by=join_by("Species"=="Species", "GeneID"=="GeneID", "VastID"=="EventID")) %>%
  left_join(all_taus_conserved_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  left_join(all_PSI_ranks_df, by=c("VastID", "Species")) %>%
  mutate(AS_type = ifelse(AS_type != "TS_AS", "NO_AS", AS_type))


###################################
###### GET CLADE-SPECIFIC EXOGs ###
###################################

clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = data.frame()
### Cycle on all clades
for (clade in all_clades) {
  ### Isolate species of the clade in question
  clade_species = get(clade)
  ### Select earliest diverging species. If most recent nodes, select both daughter species
  last_species = clade_species[length(clade_species)]
  if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {last_species = clade_species}
  
  ### Select exon orthogroups with Neural TS-AS in that clade
  TS_AS_exon_orthogroups = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
    ### Require earliest diverging species to be Neural. Require that none of the species outside the clade to be Neural.
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    ### Require that the earliest diverging species are Neural or Neural-like. Require that NONE of the other species is neural or neural-like.
    filter(
      any((Species %in% last_species & Tissue==tissue) | (Species %in% last_species & Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue), na.rm = TRUE) &
      !any(!(Species %in% clade_species) & (Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ### Select Neural and Neural-like TS-AS exons for the species belonging to each clade
    filter(Species %in% clade_species) %>%
    filter(Tissue == tissue | (Tau >= 0.6 & Top_tissue == tissue)) %>%
    ### Compute total numbers of Neural exons in each orthogroups
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
    summarize(Tot_AS_species = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    ### Require at least 50% of the species to have at least one Neural exons. In case of the earliest diverging nodes, require BOTH species.
    filter(Tot_AS_species >= if (clade %in% c("Euarchontoglires", "Cyclorrapha")) {length(clade_species)} else 
      {0.5 * length(clade_species)}) %>%
    dplyr::select(ExOG_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    .$ExOG_ID
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  ### The selected ExOG_IDs are considered R-conserved in the relative clade.
  clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(ExOG_ID = TS_AS_exon_orthogroups,
                                Clade = rep(clade, length(TS_AS_exon_orthogroups))))
}


#######################################################
################ ADD EXTRA CATEGORIES #################
#######################################################

### Classify the exon orthogroups containing G-conserved Neural TS-exons that we failed to clearly classify
other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  ### Exclude the classified conserved exons
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% as.vector(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df$ExOG_ID))) %>%
  ### Only select truly Neural TS-AS exons
  filter(AS_type == "TS_AS", Tissue == tissue) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, Species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ### Compute the number of species with Neural TS-AS exons
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Tot_TS_species = n()) %>%
  ### All this sequence of conditions work from the bottom up:
  ### If there are Neural species on both branches that do not respect the criteria for ancestrality (see below): Others
  mutate(Category = "Others-Bilateria") %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Deuterostoma), "Unclear-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there two or more  Neural species on the vertebrate branch: Unclear insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(all(Species %in% Protostoma), "Unclear-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species vertebrata
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Deuterostoma, "Single_species-Vertebrata", Category)) %>%
  ### If there only one Neural species on the vertebrate branch, single-species insecta
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Tot_TS_species == 1 & Species %in% Protostoma, "Single_species-Insecta", Category)) %>%
  ### If there are at least one vertebrate, one insects, one vertebrate outgroup and one insect outgroup: acnestral biltateria.
  mutate(Category = ifelse(any(Species %in% Vertebrata) & any(Species %in% Insecta) & any(Species %in% c("Bla", "Sp2")) & any(Species %in% c("Sma", "Obi")) & Tot_TS_species >= 9, "Ancestral-Bilateria", Category)) %>%
  separate(Category, c("Category", "Clade_group"), remove=TRUE, sep="-") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Species) %>%
  distinct()

########################################################
################ CLASSIFY UNCLEAR ONES #################
########################################################

#### I think the unclear cases might be cases of TS loss rather than anything else
### The idea is that if the TS-AS exons only differ for -/+ 3nt, they are likely the same ancestral exon even if their phylogenetic distribution does not truly suppoer that
unclear_conservation_cases_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(Category == "Unclear")
  
#### Select those unclear cases where all TS exons have the same length (-/+3).
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>% 
  inner_join(unclear_conservation_cases_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>% 
  filter(Tissue==tissue) %>% 
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(Avg_exon_length = mean(exon_length, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ExOG_ID, exon_length, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  mutate(original_exon_length = exon_length) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  mutate(exon_length = {x = sort(unique(exon_length))
      is_chain <- all(diff(x) == 3)
      small_group <- length(x) <= 3
      if (is_chain && small_group) {min(x)} else {exon_length}}) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-original_exon_length) %>%
  ###
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID, Clade_group, Tot_TS_species, Avg_exon_length) %>%
  summarize(Number_lengths = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Number_lengths == 1) %>%
  .$ExOG_ID

#### These unclear cases are labelled as conserved, setting their emergence to the LCA of all species with Neural TS-AS exons.
unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  filter(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_vector) %>%
  ### Filter with the TS requirements
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  group_by(ExOG_ID) %>%
  summarize(Clade = find_LCA_clade(unique(Species), clade_list), .groups="drop") #%>%

########################################################
################ UPDATE CLASSIFICATIONS ################
########################################################

### Update previous dataframes to include the new classification
clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df = clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df)

other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df = other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df %>%
  filter(!(ExOG_ID %in% unclear_ExOGs_as_conserved_df$ExOG_ID)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Category == "Unclear", "Others", Category))

##################################
########## COLOR SET UP ##########
##################################

if (tissue == "Neural") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"= "#08306B", "Conserved"= "#08519C", "Single_species"="#C6DBEF", "Others"="#F7FBFF")}
if (tissue == "Muscle") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"=  "#00441B", "Conserved"=  "#006D2C", "Single_species"="#E5F5E0", "Others"="#F7FCF5")}
if (tissue == "Testis") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved"="#DD3497", "Conserved"=  "#F768A1", "Single_species"="#FDE0DD", "Others"="#FFF7F3")}
if (tissue == "Ovary") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#882E72", "Conserved" = "#A24A8A", "Single_species" = "#D8B4C8", "Others" = "#F4EAF0")}
if (tissue == "Kidney") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#F7F056", "Conserved" = "#FAF27A", "Single_species" = "#FEF7C9", "Others" = "#FFFDEB")}
if (tissue == "Epithelial") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#7BAFDE", "Conserved" = "#9CC3E6", "Single_species" = "#D6E6F4", "Others" = "#F1F6FB")}
if (tissue == "DigestiveTract") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#F1932D", "Conserved" = "#F5AE5E", "Single_species" = "#FAD7B3", "Others" = "#FEF1E6")}
if (tissue == "Adipose") {conservation_colors = c("Highly_conserved" = "#DC050C", "Conserved" = "#E84A4F", "Single_species" = "#F4B4B6", "Others" = "#FCEAEA")}

################################
######## INPUT #################
################################

### Get lenghts of Neural exons belonging to the conserved and highly conserved exons
conserved_TS_exon_lenght_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  inner_join(clade_specific_TS_AS_ExOG_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>%
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Clade %in% c("Bilateria", "Deuterostoma", "Vertebrata", "Protostoma", "Insecta", "Chordata", "Arthropoda"), "Highly_conserved", "Conserved")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GeneID, VastID, Tissue, exon_length, Category)

### Get lengths of Neural exons belonging to otherr conservation classes
other_conserved_exon_lenght_df = AS_info_vastID_exon_orthogroups_df %>%
  inner_join(other_TS_ExOGs_classification_df, by="ExOG_ID") %>%
  filter(Tissue == tissue) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GeneID, VastID, Tissue, exon_length, Category) %>%
  mutate(Category = as.vector(as.character(Category))) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(grepl("shared", Category), "Unclear", Category)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(grepl("Single_species", Category), "Single_species", Category)) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(grepl("Ancestral", Category), "Highly_conserved", Category))


#################################################################
###### INTEGRATE AS INFO ########################################
#################################################################

### For the main figure, only plot lenghts in human and drosophila
plot_input_df = conserved_TS_exon_lenght_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(other_conserved_exon_lenght_df) %>%
  filter(!is.na(exon_length)) %>%
  filter(Category %in% c("Highly_conserved", "Conserved", "Single_species")) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Highly_conserved", "Conserved", "Single_species"))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels=ordered_species))


###############################
######## PLOT #################
###############################

all_length_comparison_plot = ggplot(data=plot_input_df, aes(x=Category, y=exon_length, fill=Category)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, color="black", size=0.3, alpha=0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=conservation_colors, name="TS conservation\nstatus:", labels=c("Single_species"="One TS species", "Highly_conserved"="Highly conserved")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color="black", face="bold"),
        legend.position="right") +
  ylab("Exon length") +
  xlab("") +
  guides(fill="none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,300)) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", ref.group = "Highly_conserved", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = FALSE, step.increase = 0.08,  label.y = 250, size=5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("Single_species"="One TS species", "Highly_conserved"="Highly conserved")) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol=4, scales="free_y", labeller = as_labeller(c(species_labels, "Mdo"="Mdo", "Gga"="Gga", "Xtr"="Xtr", "Dre"="Dre", "Cmi"="Cmi", 
                                                                         "Bla"="Bla", "Dme"="Dme", "Eba"="Eba", "Aae"="Aae", "Bmo"="Bmo", 
                                                                         "Tca"="Tca", "Ame"="Ame", "Bge"="Bge", "Cdi"="Cdi", "Sma"="Sma", "Obi"="Obi")))

print(all_length_comparison_plot)


###############################
######## SAVE TO FILE #########
###############################

pdf("/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/tmp_images/paper_images/SupFig10-v2.pdf", width=13.5, height=16)
print(all_length_comparison_plot)
dev.off()

```

```{r commpute_TS-AS_TS-GE_contingency_table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dependson=c("setup", "functions")}

### The idea is to see how many of the TS-GE genes pass the coverage cutoffs to be eligible for TS-AS quantification.
### We could see if the actual overlap ocurs more or less than expected by chance
### This is probably some kind of fisher test

################################
########## INPUT ###############
################################

all_species_TS_GE_with_AS_coverage_df = data.frame()
for (species in ordered_species) {
  ### For debugging
  print(species)
  ### Upload EventID - GeneID correspondence
  eventID_geneID_file = paste0("/users/mirimia/fmantica/projects/bilaterian_AS/data/DB/event_gene_correspondences/", species, ".Event-Gene.IDs.txt")
  eventID_geneID_df = read.delim(eventID_geneID_file, header=TRUE)
  ### Upload TS-GE genes
  GE_regulated_df = read.delim(paste0(AS_vs_GE_reg_dir, species, "/reference/", species, "-GE_regulated_genes.tab"), header=FALSE, col.names=c("GeneID", "Tissue")) %>%
    dplyr::select("GeneID") %>%
    distinct()
  ### Upload genes with coverage for TS-AS
  all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_df = data.frame()
  for (tissue in ordered_tissues) {
    tissue_AS_coverage_file = paste0(ts_call_dir, species, "/All_dPSI10-dPSI_glob25-N4-Rep1-EX/dPSIs_", tissue, ".tab")
    if (file.exists(tissue_AS_coverage_file)) {
      tissue_AS_coverage_df = read.delim(tissue_AS_coverage_file, header=TRUE, colClasses=c(EventID="character")) %>%
        dplyr::select(EventID) %>%
        left_join(eventID_geneID_df, by="EventID") %>%
        dplyr::select(GeneID) %>%
        distinct() %>%
        ### filter only for TS-GE
        filter(GeneID %in% GE_regulated_df$GeneID)
     ### Join to all tissues df 
     all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_df = all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_df %>%
       dplyr::bind_rows(tissue_AS_coverage_df) %>%
       mutate(Species = species)
     }
  }
  
  all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_formatted_df = all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_df %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    summarize(Tot_GE_with_AS_cov = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Tot_GE = nrow(GE_regulated_df)) %>%
    mutate(Prop_GE_with_AS_cov = Tot_GE_with_AS_cov/Tot_GE)
  
  ### Join to final dataframe
  all_species_TS_GE_with_AS_coverage_df = all_species_TS_GE_with_AS_coverage_df %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(all_tissues_AS_coverage_genes_formatted_df)
}
```
